title: Marketing Manager — True Gear
description:
About Us

We're a small, passionate team based in Australia on a mission to help caravanners and adventurers stay powered up wherever the road takes them. True Gear sells high-quality portable power solutions and adventure gear — and we're genuinely stoked about what we do.



We're now looking for a motivated Marketing Manager to join us and help take things to the next level. If you love marketing and want a role where your work actually moves the needle, we'd love to hear from you.



What You'll Be Doing

This is a hands-on marketing role where you'll be getting into the data, running campaigns, and helping us grow. The main platforms you'll be working with are Google Ads, Shopify, Meta Ads 
/Instagram), and Klaviyo for email marketing.



In practice, that looks like:

Google Ads — analysing product performance, managing campaigns, and digging into keyword research. We'll train you on the advanced stuff.

Meta Ads & Klaviyo — building out email flows and running paid social campaigns.

Collaborating with the team — we're small, so your ideas matter. You'll work directly with me the owner to execute strategies that drive sales and grow the brand. Later on you'll be brainstorming and implementing your own initiatives.



What We Need From You

The must-haves are pretty simple — great communication, a collaborative attitude, and an analytical mindset. You don't need to have all the answers, but you do need to be someone who looks for them. A good understanding of Google Ads, in particular keywords is highly desirable.



Nice to have (but we'll train you if you don't):

Experience with Google Ads, especially keyword targeting

Familiarity with Meta Ads, Shopify, Klaviyo, or Canva

Familiarity with power concepts (kW, kVA, W, Wh)



About You

You're self-motivated and take ownership of your work, think critically, and you're upfront and proactive with communication — that's all we ask. If you're someone who gets excited about AI tools and loves seeing marketing results translate into real sales, you'll fit right in.



What We Offer

A tight-knit, supportive team where your work makes a real difference

Start part-time with the option to move full-time if it's a great fit — salary increases and bonuses on the table for the right person

Training and hands-on experience with the tools that matter — Google Ads, Meta, Klaviyo, and more

Flexible hours once trained

We're open to tailoring the hours, pay, and scope of the role for the right candidate

Hourly rate: $5.50–$10 depending on experience



How to Apply

Applications close May 8th at 5pm AEST. Submit your application using the form linked below — we look forward to hearing from you!

title: Experienced E-Commerce Customer Support Representative ($1M+/Month DTC Brands Only)
description:
We're a fast-growing e-commerce company running a portfolio of DTC brands, selling to customers in the US, UK, Canada and Australia. We're looking for experienced Customer Support Representatives who have already worked inside e-commerce brands doing at least $1M per month in revenue.



This is not an entry-level role. If you've never handled a high-volume Shopify inbox, please don't apply. If you have, and you're tired of working for brands with no process, read on.



WHY THE $1M/MONTH REQUIREMENT



At that size, support is a different job. Hundreds of tickets a day, subscription cancellations, chargeback threats, shipping delays hitting thousands of orders at once, macros, SLAs, escalation paths. We want people who have lived that and know how to stay fast and accurate under volume.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Work our ticket queue by
 and chat: order status, shipping delays, lost packages, refunds, returns, product questions, complaints

- Handle subscription requests (pause, skip, swap, cancel) and run our retention flow on cancellations

- De-escalate angry customers and prevent chargebacks before they happen

- Look up the order, tracking and subscription status before you reply, so the customer's problem is solved in ONE message, not three

- Review and correct AI-drafted replies before they are sent

- Flag patterns to the team (a carrier issue, a product question that keeps coming back, a broken page on the site)



HOW WE MEASURE YOU



1. Response time: every ticket answered within 4 hours, 7 days a week

2. One-touch resolution: the fewer messages it takes to fully solve a ticket, the better

3. Quality: correct policy, correct product info, warm and human tone



REQUIREMENTS



- 2+ years in e-commerce / DTC customer support

- Direct experience at one or more brands doing $1M+ per month (you'll be asked to name them)

- Excellent written English: natural, warm and clear, never robotic or scripted

- Shopify admin experience (orders, refunds, cancellations)

- Helpdesk experience: Gorgias, Zendesk, Re:amaze, Freshdesk, Richpanel or similar

- Subscription app experience: Loop, Recharge, Skio or similar

- Comfortable handling refunds, chargeback threats and retention conversations

- Self-sufficient: you read the SOP once and run with it

- Stable internet, a backup connection and a quiet workspace

- Able to work hours overlapping with US time zones, including some weekend coverage on a rotation



NICE TO HAVE



- Health, wellness, supplements or beauty niche experience

- Experience training or QA-ing other agents

- Experience working alongside AI tools in support



WHAT YOU GET



- Long-term, full-time role with a growing brand portfolio

- A written SOP and handbook with clear policies, so you're never guessing

- An in-house support system where orders, subscriptions and customer history are on one screen

- Pay based on proven experience, with raises tied to performance

- Room to grow into a senior / team lead role as the team scales



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the words "Million dollar inbox" so we know you read the whole post. Then answer:



1. Which brands have you supported that did $1M+ per month? Include the store URL, your role, and how long you worked there.

2. How many tickets did you personally handle per day, and which helpdesk and subscription tools did you use?

3. Write the reply you would send to this customer: "I cancelled my subscription last week and you charged me AGAIN. I want my money back today or I'm disputing it with my bank."

4. Your time zone and the hours you are available each day.



Applications without the answers above will not be reviewed.

title: Content Lead – Full Time
description:
🏢 Company: Get Me Links

💵 Monthly Fee: USD $2,000–2,500/month, depending on experience, plus performance bonuses

 🌍 Location: Fully remote

 🕓 Hours: Full-time (flexible, but overlap with 1pm–10pm PH time required, roughly 7am–4pm Central European / 8am–5pm Eastern European time)



🎁 What You Get

 Salary is only half the package. You'll also get:

     4 weeks of paid time off

     Performance bonuses tied to results and lead volume

     A fully remote role: work from wherever you do your best work

     Full-on SEO training from a team that does SEO for other agencies

     A real budget to get things done

     A full tool stack, with no fighting for the software you need

     A team of 3 specialists ready to execute your direction from day one

     A flexible schedule, no time tracking



💼 What You'll Be Doing

Get Me Links is an SEO and link-building agency that partners with digital marketing agencies, and we're building content into a core growth engine. As Content Lead, you'll own our content operation, both the team and the direction. YouTube is our primary platform, so you need to speak its language: hooks, retention, thumbnails, titles, pacing, and what makes people click and stay. You'll also own the content on our website, making sure it's cohesive with our videos and turns visitors into leads. You don't need to edit the videos yourself. You'll know what good looks like, direct the people who make it, and make the call on what's ready and what will convert.

 ● Own our YouTube strategy: what we publish, why, and how each video performs

 ● Own our website content, including pages, blog, and landing pages, keeping it consistent with our videos and optimized to  convert

 ● Repurpose content across social, LinkedIn, Reddit, and

 ● Review work from editors, writers, and designers before it goes out, with clear, specific feedback that makes it better

 ● Build campaigns from content that generate leads for our services

 ● Run content sprints, set priorities, and keep the team shipping on schedule

 ● Coach your team so standards rise and the same notes don't come up twice

 ● Track performance, learn what worked and why, and improve with every upload and page

 ● Keep everything consistent with the Get Me Links style and voice



🧬 Who You Are

A content leader who lives and breathes YouTube.

You watch a video and immediately see that the music doesn't match the mood, the intro drags, or the thumbnail won't get the click, and you can explain how to fix it. You follow the channels and trends where our audience spends time, and you come with ideas, not just execution. You care more about solving problems than about any single tool, and you work well independently on a remote team.



✅ Requirements

 ● Proven experience growing or managing a YouTube channel, ideally for a business, agency, or B2B brand

 ● Fluency in YouTube: analytics, retention, CTR, thumbnails, titles, and the algorithm

 ● Experience creating or managing website content (web pages, blog, or landing pages) that drives conversions

 ● Experience leading editors, writers, or creators and making their work better rather than doing it all yourself

 ● A portfolio or show reel of real work, with results (please include it)

 ● Experience marketing services: making an intangible offer clear and trustworthy

 ● Reliable internet and availability for the required overlap hours

 ● Have experience in SEO, link building, or digital marketing agencies



🔥 Bonus Points If You…

 ● Use AI tools regularly to work faster and smarter

 ● Have run campaigns on Reddit, LinkedIn, or other community-driven platforms

 ● Have worked with a remote, distributed team before



📝 How We'll Choose

We want to see the work, not just talk about it, so every applicant goes through the same three steps:

  ● Application + portfolio. For two or three videos, web pages, or campaigns, tell us what you made and what your role was,   how it performed (views, retention, CTR, traffic, leads), and what you learned and would do differently.

 ● A short interview to talk through your experience, how you lead a content team, and how you d
 what's worth publishing.

 ● A paid trial test: we'll share a sample YouTube video with some deliberate problems. You'll write feedback to its editor and outline how you'd turn it into a campaign, including how it would tie into our website. This shows us your eye, how you coach, and how you think strategically.



📬 How to Apply (Follow These Steps Precisely)

 Please
 the following to 
 with the subject:

"Content Lead – I'm [Your Name] and I Make Content That Converts"

Include:

   ● Your resume with two professional references

)

title: Process Specialist
description:
Position Overview:



The Process Specialist is responsible for creating, documenting, maintaining, and continuously improving Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) across departments. This role works closely with the Operations Manager and collaborates with Admin Operations, Resource Management, Finance, and Field teams to translate workflows, from simple to complex, into clear, scalable, and user-friendly documentation. The ideal candidate has strong process-thinking skills, excellent written and verbal communication, and experience using documentation and training platforms such as Trainual. Construction or trade-industry experience is a strong plus.



Pay Range: $7 per hour with a performance review scheduled after 90 days of employment. We believe in rewarding exceptional talents.



About Power Plus Systems:



Power Plus Systems LLC has been a dominant force in the residential electrical contracting industry for two decades, and we continue to lead the way. Our vision is to successfully wire 28,000 homes to completion by the year 2029, ensuring safe and efficient electrical solutions, thereby making a positive impact on the lives of our customers and communities. At Power Plus Systems, LLC, a position with us isn't just a job; it's an opportunity to grow and develop within a company that genuinely appreciates your contributions and dedication to our shared mission.



Objectives:

-Create, document, and maintain clear, accurate, and scalable SOPs for simple, intermediate, and advanced operational processes.

-Ensure SOPs remain current by proactively updating documentation based on process changes, system updates, and leadership direction.

-Coordinate with department leaders and subject matter experts to capture workflows accurately and translate them into user-friendly documentation.

-Write, organize, publish and manage SOPs within Trainual and other documentation or training platforms to ensure accessibility and consistency.

-Support company-wide process standardization to improve efficiency, accountability, and cross-team alignment.

-Assist with process rollouts by supporting training materials, announcements, and change documentation as needed.

title: Content Creator & Influencer Outreach
description:
Do you want more from life?



MailWorkers is growing rapidly internationally. We’re now looking for people who see a position as the beginning of something more, something that brings you closer to your dreams and goals.



If you know how to capture attention and turn it into growth, you like to see the impact of your work firsthand, and want to discover what you’re capable of achieving, this may be the opportunity you’ve been looking for.



Work remotely from anywhere. Choose your schedule. Meet new people from around the world. Take on real responsibility and see what happens when your own performance starts creating opportunities.



The Job?



You’ll help us grow internationally through content, creators, influencers and new collaborations.



You might be someone who knows how to find interesting content creators and influencers, reach out to them and turn conversations into collaborations.



Or you might be the creator yourself.



Someone who knows how to make quality videos, write interesting content, develop ideas and create material that actually gets people's attention.



Ideally, you have experience or a strong interest in areas such as fashion, art, lifestyle, content creation or marketing, and understand what makes content look and feel genuinely good.



You’ll have clear goals, proper guidance when needed, and the freedom to find your own way of getting results.



Prove yourself, take on more responsibility, and you can advance into bigger roles as we grow together.



No experience in this exact position? That’s okay, as long as you already have something to bring to it.



Maybe you’ve created videos, written content, grown a social media account, worked with influencers, done outreach, studied fashion or art, or simply have a very good eye for what catches people's attention.



We’ll give you what you need, training, structure and proper guidance, then let you discover what you can do with it.



That does not mean this is for everyone. We want real ambition and drive.



Those who know how to get things done, think creatively and know how to read between the lines.



Who Qualifies?!



We’re looking for those who aren’t afraid to try new positions. If you’re searching for bigger challenges in life, open to trying something you haven’t tried before, and curious to see how far you can go, maybe you should apply.



You’ll be given responsibility. You’ll be challenged. And if you show that you can handle it, you’ll be given more.



We’re looking for people who can show, not just tell. Ambition, creativity, drive and initiative are key here.



If you already create content, show us.



If you know how to find and approach the right creators and influencers, tell us.



If you have a portfolio, videos, social media accounts, writing, campaigns or anything else that shows what you can do, we want to see it.



We want those who want to get somewhere in life and are ready to prove it.



If you want more from life and you are ready to take on bigger challenges, real responsibility and the opportunity to grow with an international company, you might be exactly who we’re looking for.



Apply here or send your CV and a short personal letter telling us a little about yourself, what you’re good at and why you think you’d fit in at MailWorkers.



Send it directly to our Director & Owner at 
 if there’s anything else you think would tell us more about you than a CV ever could, especially examples of content you’ve created, we’d love to see it.



For those who prove themselves, there could be opportunities to work more closely with us in the Netherlands in the near future.



MailWorkers



Because people trust people.

title: AI Operations & Customer Support Specialist (Full-Time, Long-Term)
description:
We run an online service business that helps people recover and manage Instagram accounts. Our customers order through an app, and a lot of our operation runs on AI assistants that talk to customers, answer questions and move orders along.



The AI does a lot - but it cannot be left alone. That is the job.



WHAT YOU WOULD BE DOING



1) WATCHING OVER OUR AI ASSISTANTS (about half your time)



We have several AI assistants that message customers directly - one handles sales conversations, one handles order updates, one handles support tickets, and others. All of them are in your scope. Your job is to be the human checking their work:



- Read what the AI said to customers and spot anything wrong: a made-up answer, a promise we cannot keep, the wrong price, a rude or robotic reply, or the same message sent over and over

- Flag it, pause that assistant yourself if it is doing damage (you will have the controls - we would rather you stop it at 10pm than wait for us), and tell us what happened

- Notice patterns, not just one-off mistakes ("it keeps doing X with this type of customer")

- Step in and reply as a human when the AI is out of its depth



You do not need to be technical and you will not be programming. You need to be the person who reads something that sounds confident and thinks "hang on, that's not right."



2) CUSTOMER SUPPORT TICKETS (about a third of your time)



- Answer customer questions and complaints in our support system

- Chase customers for information we need to finish their order

- Keep tickets moving so nothing sits ignored for days



3) SERVICE DELIVERY (the rest)



- Complete customer orders by hand on our phones, following a written step-by-step guide

- It is roughly 10-15 minutes per order once you know it

- Tell the customer when it is done, or ask for what is missing



BEING HONEST ABOUT THE WORK



- A lot of it is repetitive. Reading AI conversations and completing the same order checklist. Some people find that steady and satisfying; others are bored in a month and quit. Please know yourself.

- It is screen-heavy and detail-heavy. Accuracy matters far more than speed.

- The hours are long and it is 6 days a week. Please only apply if that genuinely suits you.

- You will find mistakes, including ours. We want someone who says "this is wrong" rather than someone who goes along with it.

- What it is not: no cold calling, no sales targets, no content creation, no coding.



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



- Good written English. You message customers directly. It does not need to be perfect, but it must be clear, warm and typo-light.

- Judgement. The core skill is spotting when something is wrong even though it sounds convincing.

- Careful and consistent. One wrong tap can cost a customer their appeal.

- Comfortable with phones, two-factor authentication and backup codes. Not technical - just not nervous about it.

- A reliable setup. Stable internet and power for your whole shift, and a quiet place to work.

- Completely trustworthy. You will have access to customer account details. This is monitored and logged, you will sign a confidentiality agreement, and you will start on a paid trial.



Nice to have (not required): customer support, content moderation, social media management, quality assurance, or any experience working alongside AI tools.



THE DETAILS



- Pay: $4 per hour, paid hourly (about $1,040/month at 60 hours a week). Paid on time, every time.

- Hours: about 10 hours a day, 6 days a week (roughly 60 hours a week). Our customers are in Europe, so the working window is roughly 2:00pm - 11:00pm Philippine time.

- Trial: 1-2 week PAID trial on real work before we commit long-term.

- Long-term and stable. We want someone for years, not weeks.

- Real authority: you can pause an AI assistant yourself when it is doing damage. We trust the person doing the watching to act, not to file a report and wait.

- Everything is browser-based on our systems. You need a reliable computer and a stable internet connection, nothing else.

- Your rate is reviewed after the first 3 months.



HOW TO APPLY - PLEASE READ CAREFULLY



Please do not send a generic CV or a cover letter written by AI. We can tell, and it is an instant no - partly because this job is about spotting AI output.



Answer all 9 points below, in this order. Applications that skip any point will not be read.



1. Start your message with the words "human check" so we know you read this properly.



2. YOUR LAST RELEVANT JOB: where, how long, and what you actually did day to day. Please include how many customers or tickets you handled per day, and which tools you used (Zendesk, Intercom, Freshdesk, Gorgias,
,
, or none). If you have no support experience, say so plainly - willingness to learn is fine, but be honest.



3. TELL US ABOUT A REAL TIME YOU CAUGHT SOMEONE ELSE'S MISTAKE AT WORK - what it was, how you noticed, and what you did about it. One short paragraph. This is the closest thing to the actual job, so please give a real example, not a general statement.



4. READ THIS MESSAGE that an AI assistant sent to a real customer, and tell us what is wrong with it:



"Hi! Good news, we're sending the login request to your phone again right now and our team is actively working on your account as we speak. You should see it come through in the next few minutes. We'll have this fully resolved for you today, guaranteed!"



The truth at that moment: nothing was running, nobody was working on the account, and we had no idea when it would be resolved.



In your own words: what is wrong here, and why does it matter? (3-4 sentences)



5. A customer messages: "this is taking forever, I want a refund." Our policy is that we do not give refunds - we fix the problem or replace the account. Write the exact message you would send back to this customer.



6. You notice our AI has sent the same customer almost the same message 8 times in one night. What do you do, and in what order? (2-3 sentences)



7. Confirm you can work about 10 hours a day, 6 days a week, in the 2:00pm - 11:00pm Philippine time window. Also tell us your expected hourly rate in USD.



8. YOUR WORK SETUP - please be specific, because we need you online for the whole shift:

   - Your internet provider and your actual speed (a speed test screenshot is ideal)

   - Your backup if the internet goes down (mobile data, pocket wifi, a second provider?)

   - How often your area has brownouts, and what you do if the power goes out mid-shift (UPS, power bank, generator, a cafe nearby?)

   - Your computer (make and rough age), and whether you have a quiet place to work



Please be honest here. We would much rather know about a weekly brownout up front than discover it in week two. Having a backup plan matters more to us than having perfect conditions.



9. Your CV or OnlineJobs profile, plus one sentence on which part of it is most relevant to this specific job.



Everyone who follows all 9 steps gets a reply. Shortlisted candidates get a short paid test task before any interview.

title: Video Editor for AI-Generated Ads (CapCut + Higgsfield) - Full Time
description:
Hello,



We run a French ecommerce store and we advertise on Meta. We need someone to produce our video ads with AI tools, full time and long term.



THE WORK

We send you a video ad that already performs. You recreate it with our product: generate the shots with AI, add the AI voiceover, edit it, add subtitles. Nothing to film, nothing to record with your own voice.



VOLUME

We start at around 15 videos per week, and grow to 30 per week once you are up to speed. This is ongoing work, not a one-off project.



IMPORTANT: YOU DO NOT NEED TO SPEAK FRENCH. BUT IF YOU DO, EVEN BETTER.

We write every script for you. Your job is to copy and paste the French text exactly as we send it, into the voiceover tool and into the subtitles. Never retype it, never correct it, never translate it. If a word looks misspelled to you, it is intentional, it is there so the AI voice pronounces it correctly. This is the single most important rule of the job.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- You already use AI video tools (Higgsfield, Kling, Veo, Runway or similar). You come with your own workflow.

- You edit fast in CapCut, or a similar editor.

- You are consistent. Steady output matters more than one perfect video.

- You follow a brief exactly, without improvising.



WHAT WE OFFER

A stable, long-term, full-time role with a real company and a real ad budget. Your videos actually run, and you get the results back. As you grow, the role grows with you (script adaptation, choosing which ads to recreate).



HOW WE HIRE

Short form first, then a quick call, then a small paid trial task. We hire based on the trial, not on the CV.

title: Executive Assistant / Operations VA – Online Business | Long-Term Role
description:
Hi! I'm Maddie, the founder of an Australian online business, and I'm looking for a highly organised, proactive Executive Assistant / Operations VA to become my right-hand person.



This isn't a role where I want to provide you with a list of tiny tasks every morning.



I want someone who eventually knows what's happening across the business and helps make sure nothing falls through the cracks.



My brain works quickly. I have lots of ideas and I'm very good at creating, problem-solving, working with clients and growing the business.

I need someone whose brain naturally thinks:

“What needs to happen next?”

“Has anyone followed this up?”

“Did Maddie remember this?”

“Is every client taken care of?”

“How can I make this easier next time?”



Initially this role will combine Executive Assistant + Operations support.

As the business grows, there is significant opportunity for the role to grow too.



WHAT YOU'LL HELP OWN

You'll help with things such as:

- Managing my priorities and task list

- Following up outstanding tasks

- Inbox/admin support

- Calendar and scheduling

- Client onboarding and offboarding

- Maintaining client/program records

- Following up clients who haven't completed required actions

- Preparing for meetings/calls

- Capturing action items and making sure they happen

- Maintaining SOPs and business documentation

- Organising files and systems

- Supporting our online programs/community

- Checking that scheduled
s, calls and deliverables are ready

- General operational/admin support

- Helping coordinate contractors/team members

- Creating simple daily/weekly reporting

- Identifying things that are falling through the cracks BEFORE I have to notice them



THERE'S ANOTHER IMPORTANT PART OF THIS ROLE

I want our clients and team to feel looked after.

That means noticing things.

Someone has a big win? We celebrate it.

New client joins? They're welcomed properly.

Birthday coming up? We know about it.

Someone hasn't completed onboarding? We check in.

Someone asks a question and hasn't received an answer? You notice.

Team member needs something? It gets handled.

I want someone helping me create a business where everyone feels the love AND everything actually gets done.



WHAT I'D LOVE FROM YOU

Eventually, I'd love an EOD update that looks something like:

DONE TODAY

- Client onboarding completed

- Thursday call reminder sent

- Outstanding invoice followed up

- Program records updated



NEEDS YOUR ATTENTION

- Sarah needs an answer about X

- Approval required for Y



I'VE ALREADY HANDLED

- Jess hadn't completed onboarding, so I followed up

- Client had a win in the community, so I acknowledged it and flagged it for you



TOMORROW

- Your three priorities are X, Y and Z

That level of ownership would make me extremely happy.



YOU'LL BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU:

- Are exceptionally organised

- Are proactive rather than reactive

- Have excellent written English

- Communicate warmly and professionally

- Have very strong attention to detail

- Enjoy creating order

- Follow through without needing to be chased

- Are comfortable reminding ME when I'm the bottleneck

- Think ahead

- Learn software quickly

- Can prioritise rather than treating every task as equally urgent

- Are trustworthy and discreet

- Genuinely enjoy helping people feel taken care of



EXPERIENCE THAT WOULD BE HELPFUL

Experience as an:

- Executive Assistant

- Online Business Manager

- Operations Assistant

- Client Success VA

- Project Coordinator



Experience with online businesses, coaches, consultants, memberships or digital programs would be particularly useful.

Bonus experience:

- GoHighLevel

- Notion

- Google Workspace

- CRM systems

-
 marketing platforms

- Online communities/course platforms

- Basic bookkeeping/invoice administration



You do NOT need all of these.

Good judgement, initiative and reliability matter more to me.



ROLE DETAILS

- Part-time initially

- Strong potential to grow into a substantial long-term position

- Paid trial for shortlisted candidates

- Start ASAP



HOW TO APPLY

Please send:

1. A short introduction.

2. Your CV/resume.

3. Your current availability.

4. Your expected hourly and/or monthly rate.

5. What systems/software you've worked with.

6. Tell me about a role where you were responsible for keeping a busy founder/business organised.



And answer this question carefully:

Tell me about a time you noticed something was going to become a problem BEFORE your client/boss noticed it. What did you do?



I'm much more interested in your answer to that than a giant list of software you've used.



Please don't send a generic copy/paste application.



Shortlisted applicants will complete a paid practical trial based on a realistic scenario from my business.



I'm looking for someone who wants to become a genuine part of the business rather than simply complete assigned tasks.

title: Junior Web & Frontend Designer
description:
'golfscape' is the first and largest worldwide golf booking platform, founded in London, United Kingdom, and operating in over 100 destinations around the globe. We are a fast-paced startup revolutionizing the traditional golf world with industry-leading technology and marketing. We’re proud to lead innovation in this space and are always pushing forward.



You’ll be joining a small, dedicated, and success-driven team that’s making a global impact in the golf industry. We’re a distributed, multi-cultural, and multi-talented group who works collaboratively and values initiative, creativity, and growth.



Role Overview

As a Junior Web & Front-end Designer, you will support the design and development of engaging digital experiences across our platform. This is a hands-on learning opportunity ideal for someone early in their career, looking to grow their skills in a fast-paced and collaborative environment.



Key Responsibilities

- Assist in designing and iterating on web pages, landing pages, and
 layouts.

Ideal Candidate

- A strong portfolio showcasing creativity, attention to detail, and a good understanding of design principles.

- Comfortable using Figma or similar design tools (Adobe Suite, Sketch, etc.).

title: Real Estate Dispositions Manager (Remote) - US$6/hour + Commission
description:
We are hiring a Real Estate Dispositions Manager (fully remote). You will own dispositions end to end: taking a property from the moment it lands with us through to a signed assignment with a cash buyer, building the agent relationships that bring us deals, and managing the renovation work on the properties we keep.



This is a base plus commission role. Commission is paid on every deal you sell, and at a higher rate on deals you source yourself.



This is not a general admin VA role. Please read the two requirements below before applying.



REQUIRED, both of these:

1) Prior dispositions experience in US real estate. You have personally moved wholesale contracts to cash buyers.

2) You have sourced deals through real estate agents. Specific properties that came to you through an agent relationship and went to contract.

A PLUS, NOT REQUIRED:

Rehab project management. If you have personally run a renovation - the scope, the budget, the contractors, the timeline - tell us and it counts in your favour. If you have not, it will not rule you out. We are hiring on dispositions first.



You will be:

- Triaging every incoming deal within one business day

- Chasing the missing photos, reports and contracts from wholesalers

- Building and qualifying the buyer list, then presenting deals to named buyers by phone

- Quoting prices, handling objections and negotiating assignments through to signature

- Building an agent network and sourcing deals through it

- Running rehab projects: scopes of work, contractor bids, budget and timeline tracking, progress reporting



Requirements:

- Excellent, clear English, confident on the phone with US buyers, agents and contractors

- Able to work Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time (40 hours per week)

- Comfortable in a real estate CRM. We use Podio. Podio, InvestorFuse, GoHighLevel, REISift, Salesforce or similar all count

- A distraction free home office with reliable high speed internet and a computer that can run multiple applications

- Comfortable with screenshot monitoring on your own computer and staying in a muted team Zoom room during your shift



Pay: US$6 per hour plus commission.



To apply, please reply with the following FIVE things:

1) A short video or audio introducing yourself in English, covering your dispositions experience and ONE deal you sourced through a real estate agent (Loom, Vocaroo, Google Drive, or unlisted YouTube). APPLICATIONS WITHOUT A VIDEO OR AUDIO WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED.

2) How many wholesale contracts you have personally dispositioned, over what period, and in which markets.

3) One deal you got from a real estate agent, from the first conversation through to a signed contract.

4) If you have managed a rehab project, describe one: the scope, the budget, the timeline, and what went wrong. If you have not managed one, just say so - it will not count against you.

5) How many years you have worked in US real estate, and confirmation that you can work Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time.

title: Senior Google Ads & Meta Ads Manager — Healthcare Vertical (Full-Time, WFH)
description:
JOB TITLE: Senior Google Ads & Meta Ads Manager — Healthcare Vertical (Full-Time, WFH)



Company: Established Australian digital marketing agency, operating for over 15 years, specialising in marketing for dental and medical practices across Australia.



Schedule: Full-time, Monday to Friday, 8:00am to 4:00pm Philippines time.



READ THIS ENTIRE POST BEFORE APPLYING



This is a senior role. We are only interested in candidates with 10+ years of hands-on paid media management experience. If you have less than 10 years, please do not apply — your application will not be considered and we will not reply.



We manage six figure monthly ad spend (AUD) across a portfolio of dental and medical practice clients, and we need someone who has genuinely done this before, not someone who has "run some campaigns."



About the role



We're looking for an absolute weapon of a paid media manager to take ownership of Google Ads and Meta Ads accounts for a portfolio of healthcare clients (dental practices, GP clinics, specialists). The work is mostly:



Google Search Ads (majority of the work) — new patient acquisition campaigns, high competition local service categories

Some Google Display Ads

Meta Ads — conversion campaigns and lead form (lead gen) campaigns



You'll be managing multiple client accounts simultaneously, each with its own budget, targeting, and compliance requirements. This is not a "set and forget" role — we need someone who lives in these accounts daily, tests constantly, and treats client budgets like they're their own money.



You must have:



10+ years minimum of dedicated, hands-on Google Ads and/or Meta Ads management experience (non-negotiable)

Proven experience managing six figure monthly ad spend across multiple accounts

title: Video Editor.- Conference and Interview
description:
We're looking for a skilled, reliable video editor to turn multi-camera conference sessions into polished, engaging content. The core of this job is editing full-length sessions (typically 45 to 60 minutes) by cutting between a wide camera, a close-up camera, and the presenter's slides so viewers stay engaged from start to finish. The volume is heaviest during conference season, with steady work year-round.



What You'll Edit



- Full-length keynote and session videos, switching between wide shot, close-up, and slides throughout

- Conference recap and highlight reels

- Speaker and attendee interview segments

- Short vertical clips (9:16) for Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn

- Promo and sizzle videos for upcoming events



Responsibilities



- Build full-length session edits from three sources: wide camera, close camera, and slide deck

- Make smart switching decisions: close-up for key points and emotion, wide for movement and audience moments, slides when - the on-screen content matters

- Vary pacing across long sessions so the edit never feels static or repetitive

- Use picture-in-picture or split layouts when both the speaker and the slide matter

- Keep slides in sync with what the speaker is saying

- Sync multi-cam footage and clean up audio (noise reduction, leveling)

- Add lower thirds, captions, and graphics using client brand templates

- Color match footage from mixed camera sources

- Deliver in multiple formats and aspect ratios

- Respond to revision notes quickly and accurately

- Organize project files using our naming and folder conventions



Requirements



- 3+ years of professional video editing experience

- Proven experience editing long-form multi-camera content (conferences, lectures, webinars, church services, or live events)

- Strong proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro (After Effects is a plus)

- Strong English comprehension. You'll be cutting American speakers and need to understand context, humor, and when a point lands.

- Reliable internet capable of handling large files (50GB+ projects)

- At least 3 hours of daily overlap with US Mountain Time

- Your own editing workstation and Adobe license



Nice to Have



- Experience with sports or conference content

- Motion graphics and animated captions

- Familiarity with 
, Asana, and Slack

title: Performance Marketing Manager (Google Ads & Meta Ads)
description:
ABOUT US



We're NH Repairs, a commercial truck, trailer, fleet, and RV repair business in South Florida. We spend real money on paid ads and we're looking for someone to own our entire digital customer acquisition. Not someone who just logs into Google Ads, adjusts bids, and reports on impressions. We want someone who brings in real paying customers.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN



From day one, you'll manage our Google Ads and Meta 
/Instagram) advertising, including:



*Google Search campaigns and Performance Max

*Keyword and search-term analysis, negative keyword management

*Geographic targeting and campaign structure

*Ad copy, offers, and A/B testing

*Conversion tracking, call tracking, GA4 and GTM

*Meta and Instagram ads and retargeting

*Landing page testing and optimization

*Competitor research

*Reporting on qualified leads and cost per qualified lead



As you settle in, this grows to include building new landing pages, AI-assisted website and ad creative, lead funnels, CRM integrations, and conversion rate optimization.



You don't need to be a developer, but you do need to be comfortable with landing page builders, WordPress or similar, and modern AI tools, enough to build and improve pages without needing a developer for every small change.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



We do not care about impressions, clicks, CTR, or Google's optimization score. We measure success by qualified phone calls, qualified service requests, cost per qualified lead, estimates generated, jobs sold, revenue, and gross profit. Our best customers are local businesses and fleets running trucks, trailers, commercial vehicles, or equipment.



REQUIREMENTS (you should apply if you)



Have strong hands-on Google Ads experience

Have managed meaningful monthly ad spend across both Google and Meta

Understand Google Search and Performance Max deeply, and know when to use each

Understand conversion tracking and attribution

Can diagnose weak campaign performance instead of blaming the client or the market

Understand landing page conversion optimization

Use AI tools well

Write and speak excellent English

Are comfortable working with data

Work independently, with minimal supervision

Think commercially: you ask "did this bring in profitable customers," not "did traffic go up"



Bonus: experience with local service businesses (automotive, trucking, repair, home services, medical, or other phone-call-driven businesses).



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF



You need daily direction on what to do

You measure your work by clicks, impressions, or traffic

You've only run small campaigns

You can't explain where leads actually come from

You just apply Google's recommendations without questioning them



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the words: "Qualified Leads Matter." Applications that skip this won't be reviewed.



We can tell when answers are written with ChatGPT, so instead of typing your answers, please record one Loom video (10 to 15 minutes) where you:



1. Screen-share a real Google Ads and/or Meta account you've managed (blur the client name if needed) and walk through how it's structured.

2. Answer out loud, unscripted: you inherit an account spending $8,000/month for a local service business and leads drop sharply. What are the first five things you check, and how do you tell whether the problem is traffic volume, traffic quality, tracking, the landing page, or the sales team?

3. Talk through Google Search vs Performance Max, when you'd use each, using a real example from your own work.

4. Show one account where you clearly improved performance: actual spend, the problem, what you changed, and before-and-after numbers on screen.

5. List the tools you've actually used for Google Ads, GA4, GTM, call tracking, landing pages, Meta Ads, and AI tools.

6. Walk through how you'd approach your first 30 days managing our account.



Finalists will have a short live call to verify the account work shown in the video. Generic or unverifiable applications will be deprioritized.

title: DTC VIDEO EDITOR — UGC META ADS USING AI TOOLS
description:
Mon–Fri | $650–$850/month + performance bonuses



I run a small DTC operation with the resources to scale further. We create

mostly AI UGC-style video ads, so I'm looking for someone very comfortable

using AI tools to create high-quality ad creatives fast.



The creatives you make run as paid ads on Meta —
 and Instagram

feeds, reels, and stories.



This is NOT a "make things look cinematic" job. This is a marketing-first

editing role. Every cut, every caption, every transition exists for one

reason: to stop the scroll and drive the click. If a beautiful transition

doesn't help the ad convert, it doesn't go in.



HOW WE OPERATE

We run three stores. One is a US-made product, long-term brand. The other

two are testing stores where we validate new dropshipping products.



This matters for how you'll work. One week I might need a few creatives for

the US brand. The next week the focus shifts entirely to a testing product.

The workload moves with demand. The workflow stays the same. Nothing changes.



To be clear: this is NOT a role where I expect 50 creatives a week for each

store. What I need is someone who can switch between stores without losing

quality and move fast and loose when we're testing something new.



THE STYLE WE MAKE — READ THIS CAREFULLY

Everything we produce is UGC-style: ads that look like a real person filmed

themselves on a phone, not like a brand commercial. That is the entire point.

The moment an ad looks polished or produced, people recognize it as an ad

and scroll past.



In practice that means:

- Talking-head delivery, straight to camera, casual and unscripted-feeling

- Handheld energy, imperfect framing, natural lighting — not studio-clean

- Hard cuts every 2–4 seconds, no fancy transitions, no cinematic color grades

- Big readable captions burned in, because most people watch with sound off

- B-roll cut in to show the product doing the thing being talked about

- The first 2 seconds must stop the scroll or nothing else matters



The hard part with AI: making an AI avatar and AI voiceover feel like a real

person instead of a corporate presenter. If your HeyGen output looks like a

news anchor, it will not convert. Prompting and editing your way to something

that feels human is the core skill I'm hiring for.



MUST KNOW HOW TO PROMPT AND USE:

Higgsfield (Image / Video generations — mostly B-ROLL)

HeyGen (Avatar / Video generations) -> Mostly Talking Heads

ElevenLabs (Voice overs)

ChatGPT / Claude (For prompting)

Notion (our business operates in Notion) (Simple use)

Google Drive (where we organize and save videos/assets)

CapCut and/or Adobe Premiere Pro

title: Clinical and Office Manager VA
description:
Clinical and Office Manager VA

Scheduler, Follow-Up, Post-Surgical Care & Chart Preparation Specialist



Work Schedule:

Must be able to work Hawaii Time, Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM



Required Qualifications:

This is a clinical role. Applicants must:



Hold a nursing degree



Have healthcare/nursing knowledge



Have at least 12 months of bedside nursing experience

Only candidates with a nursing background should apply.



Objectives of the Role



The Clinical and Office Manager VA serves as the primary clinical point of contact for patients, guiding them through the full care journey—from referral and scheduling through post-operative recovery. They oversee clinic virtual assistants (VAs), mentor administrative staff, and lead process-improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency, collaboration, and patient satisfaction.



Key Responsibilities

A. Leadership & Team Management



Supervise and coordinate the daily work of clinic virtual assistants



Assign tasks, monitor completion, and ensure quality standards are met



Provide training, mentorship, and feedback to strengthen team performance



Develop performance metrics and track outcomes to guide raises and bonuses



B. Referral Review & Pre-Visit Preparation



Review incoming referrals for appropriateness and completeness



Contact referring providers for clarification when needed



Lead the collection and organization of patient records (imaging, labs, operative reports, consultation notes)



Ensure the physician has a complete, ready-to-use clinical note in Elation Health EMR for each visit



C. Clinical Follow-Up & Post-Operative Care



Manage post-operative communication and follow-up scheduling



Send recovery plans and instructions via phone or text



Monitor patient recovery progress and escalate concerns appropriately



Track patient feedback and identify trends in satisfaction



D. Chart Preparation & EMR Management



Prepare and maintain complete, accurate patient charts



Send patient visit summaries with clear action items and timelines



Ensure all pre-procedure requirements (consents, cardiac clearance, labs, EKGs, etc.) are completed at least two weeks before surgery



E. Patient Documentation & Administrative Support



Complete patient paperwork such as work notes, FMLA forms, and school letters



Coordinate with external offices, labs, and imaging centers



Refine scripts and templates for consistent patient communication



F. Scheduling & Daily Operations

Daily Checklist



Review and validate new referrals and schedule patients for clinic visits



Assign and oversee VA tasks for the day



Gather records and prepare consultation notes



Monitor post-operative follow-ups and schedule as needed



Communicate with administrative assistants regarding system improvements



Weekly Checklist



Audit referral and pre-visit preparation completeness



Review team performance against established metrics



Provide feedback and refine workflows to improve efficiency



Submit reports on patient care quality, productivity, and system improvements



Redundancy Protocol



If the Clinical and Office Manager is unavailable, VA2 and VA3 will assume responsibility for urgent follow-ups and record collection to ensure continuity of care. The Clinical and Office Manager serves as VA2’s direct manager and assists with workflow management across the entire team.



If unavailable for follow-up communication or patient feedback tasks, VA1 or VA3 will provide coverage.



Performance & Metrics



Establish measurable benchmarks for team productivity, patient satisfaction, documentation accuracy, and turnaround times



Monitor progress and identify areas for improvement



Recommend raises or bonuses every six months based on objective performance and value added to the practice



Ongoing Clinical Responsibilities



Manage post-operative communication and follow-up visits



Collect patient feedback via surveys and digital tools



Prepare personalized recovery plans



Track patient outcomes and document notes in Elation Health EMR



Send post-operative instructions by text or phone



After each visit, send a Patient Summary of Visit including to-do items and due dates



Send consent instructions via 
 and follow up on cardiac clearance, EKGs, and labs two weeks prior to procedures



Complete patient documentation such as work notes, family leave forms, and school letters



Scripts & Templates



Post-Operative Follow-Up:

“Hello [Patient Name], we hope you’re feeling well after your procedure. Please let us know if you’re experiencing any issues or need further assistance.”



Feedback Request:

“We would appreciate your feedback on your experience with us. Please complete this brief survey: [Link].”

description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Certification is performance-based, usually reviewed after 30-60 days, and requires consistent performance, quality-control review, and leadership approval



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- Core client coverage: 6 AM-12 PM PH time

- Split shifts are allowed

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Required team/training meetings may happen around 9 PM-11 PM PH time

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- Final schedule will be agreed during hiring and must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.



Most clients are U.S.-based, and many are age 45+, so patience, clarity, emotional intelligence, and professional English communication are very important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

- Keep clients accountable to action items and deadlines

- Follow up with stuck, quiet, inactive, or delayed clients

- Re-engage clients before momentum is lost

- Join required trainings, daily team Zoom calls, and feedback sessions

- Once activated, host a weekly client-support call or own a similar client-success responsibility



CLIENT LOAD



You will ramp gradually.



The target for a Certified CSM is 40-50 active clients, depending on client complexity, program type, and client inflow.



When fewer clients are available, CSMs may support reactivation, offboarding, client check-ins, and legacy-client cleanup.



BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for after the test month where applicable

- Afternoons and early evenings generally free, with required evening meetings

- Currently based in the Philippines

- Fluent, professional English

- Clear and easily understood verbal communication

- Strong communication and emotional intelligence

- Calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

- Reliable internet connection and professional home setup

- Willing to use Hubstaff during working hours

- Able to work PH morning / U.S. evening hours

- Comfortable with split shifts and required evening meetings

- Able to manage up to 40-50 active clients once trained and certified

- Able to meet certification standards without heavy supervision

- Able to identify and escalate refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and client-satisfaction risks quickly



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success

- Coaching

- High-ticket programs

- Online education

- Social media monetization

- Content strategy

- Creator economy

- AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, or Submagic

- Working with U.S. clients



WE’RE THE RIGHT FIT IF



You’ll likely thrive here if you:

title: SCHEDULER (REMOTE) | PLUMBING, ELECTRICAL & HOME SERVICES
description:
High-Performance Reactive Scheduling & Dispatch Role



We are looking for an experienced Scheduler to take control of the daily scheduling and dispatch operations for Plumbing Bros Corporate (Perth).



This is NOT an administration role with some scheduling responsibilities. Scheduling and dispatch must be your primary experience.



We are specifically looking for someone who has worked in plumbing, electrical, HVAC, maintenance, pest control, or another high-volume home services environment, where you have been responsible for scheduling technicians, taking customer calls, creating jobs/orders, and constantly adjusting the schedule throughout the day.



If your background is primarily general administration, data entry, customer service, or virtual assistance without substantial scheduling/dispatch experience, please do not apply.



ABOUT THE ROLE



You will be the command centre of our daily operations.

This is a fast-paced, reactive environment with a high volume of incoming calls and jobs.

You need to be comfortable doing multiple things at once:



???? Taking customer and technician calls

???? Creating orders/jobs in the system while on the phone

???? Scheduling and dispatching technicians

???? Rebuilding schedules when priorities change

???? Responding quickly to urgent jobs and changing circumstances

???? Managing technician locations, availability, and job runs



The day will not always go according to plan — and that's exactly why we need an experienced reactive Scheduler.

You must be able to think on your feet, make decisions quickly, and keep control of the schedule even when the phone is constantly ringing.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Scheduling & Dispatch

Schedule and dispatch plumbers across daily job runs

Allocate jobs based on technician availability, location, skills and priority

Manage a high volume of jobs without losing control or accuracy

Monitor technician progress throughout the day

Adjust schedules in real time as jobs run over, cancel, become urgent or change priority

Minimise technician downtime and unnecessary travel

Keep technicians productive and moving throughout the day

Identify gaps in the schedule and proactively fill them

High-Volume Calls & Customer Coordination

Answer a high volume of incoming calls

Speak confidently and professionally with customers and technicians

Gather the information required to create accurate jobs/orders

Create orders/jobs while speaking with customers on the phone

Determine job urgency and prioritise appropriately

Manage customer expectations around availability and arrival times

Handle changes, cancellations and urgent requests quickly

Communicate schedule changes to technicians and customers



Reactive Operations

This is one of the most important parts of the role.

You need to be able to react immediately when the plan changes.



For example:

A plumber is running 45 minutes late ? you need to immediately assess the schedule, contact affected customers, rearrange jobs and keep the rest of the day moving.

An emergency job comes through ? you need to determine priority, identify the appropriate technician and reorganise the schedule.

A technician finishes early ? you need to identify the next suitable job and get them moving.

A customer cancels ? you need to identify how to use that newly available time.

You cannot wait for someone else to tell you what to do.



THIS ROLE REQUIRES MULTITASKING

You need to be comfortable with:

???? Phone ringing

???? Creating an order

???? Updating the schedule

???? Checking technician availability

???? Communicating with technicians

???? Responding to urgent jobs

???? Reorganising the day's schedule

— all at the same time.



If you become overwhelmed when several things happen simultaneously, this role will not be a good fit.



EXPERIENCE REQUIRED



???? SCHEDULING / DISPATCH EXPERIENCE IS ESSENTIAL



Your primary professional experience must be in scheduling, dispatch, or service coordination.

We are specifically looking for candidates with experience scheduling technicians in industries such as:

???? Plumbing

? Electrical

?? HVAC / Air Conditioning

???? Home Services

????? Maintenance Services

???? Pest Control

???? Automotive / Mobile Services

Other high-volume field service businesses

Strongly Preferred

Experience scheduling plumbers or electricians

Experience in a high-volume service environment

Experience handling a high volume of inbound calls

Experience creating jobs/orders while speaking with customers

Experience dispatching technicians

Experience managing same-day and urgent jobs

Experience with Ascora is highly advantageous

Experience with other field-service/job-management software

Understanding of technician territories, travel time and job allocation



DO NOT APPLY IF...

? Scheduling has not been your primary experience.

? Your experience is primarily general administration.

? Your experience is primarily data entry.

? Your experience is primarily bookkeeping or finance.

? Your experience is primarily customer service without scheduling/dispatch responsibilities.

? You have only occasionally helped with scheduling.

? You have never managed technician schedules.

? You have never worked in a high-volume service environment.

We are not looking to train someone from scratch in scheduling.

We need someone who can step into the role and operate confidently from Day 1.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

The right person will:

Have significant hands-on scheduling/dispatch experience

Understand how plumbing/electrical/home service businesses operate

Be highly reactive and comfortable with constant change

Think 2–3 steps ahead

Make quick, sensible decisions

Remain calm when the phone is constantly ringing

Have excellent attention to detail

Be extremely organised

Have a strong sense of urgency

Take ownership rather than waiting for instructions

Communicate clearly and confidently

Be comfortable challenging inefficient processes

Understand that getting the right technician to the right job at the right time matters

WORKING HOURS

Monday – Friday

???? 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Perth Time

1-hour unpaid lunch break

Optional paid overtime may be available depending on workload.

WHY JOIN US?

Work with a growing national Australian brand

Become a critical part of the daily operations team

Work within structured systems and processes

High-performance environment with clear expectations

Opportunity to make a measurable impact on operational performance

Work alongside an experienced operations team

Clear accountability and ownership

FINAL NOTE — PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING

This is a high-pressure, high-responsibility scheduling role.

Our phones can be busy. Jobs can change. Technicians can run late. Emergency work can come in. Customers need updates. Orders need to be created.

You need to be able to handle all of this without losing control.

We are looking for a reactive Scheduler — not an administrator who can schedule.

If your primary experience is scheduling and dispatching technicians in plumbing, electrical, home services, or another high-volume field-service environment, we want to hear from you.

If scheduling is not your primary experience, please do not apply.

title: Content Marketing Specialist / Content Operator – Social Media, Reels & Online Business
description:
Hi! I'm Maddie, the founder of an Australian online business, and I'm looking for an exceptional Content Marketing Specialist / Content Operator to work closely with me and take ownership of our content and social media.



This is NOT a traditional Social Media VA role.



I'm not looking for someone who needs me to provide a finished caption, Canva template and posting instructions.

I'm looking for someone with the slightly difficult-to-find combination of:

1. A strong marketing brain

2. Excellent creative/design taste

3. The ability to actually execute



I have a lot of ideas, strong offers, customer results, existing content and plenty of raw material.

I need someone who can take a voice note, rough idea, testimonial, talking-head video or upcoming offer and turn it into smart, beautiful, commercially useful content.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

You'll help me:

- Plan and manage our social/content calendar

- Turn my ideas and voice notes into content

- Edit talking-head Instagram Reels

- Create B-roll/Reel content

- Write strong hooks, captions and CTAs

- Create premium-looking carousels, Stories and graphics

- Turn customer testimonials/results into proof-based content

- Repurpose existing content intelligently

- Schedule and publish content

- Support launches and promotional campaigns

- Review content performance and identify what we should do more of

- Bring your own content ideas rather than waiting for instructions



Over time, I want you to understand the business well enough that I can say:

“This is what I'm selling and this is who I'm trying to reach.”

…and you can help turn that into the content we need.



CREATIVE TASTE IS VERY IMPORTANT

I've hired social media support before, and this is where I've struggled.

I want clean, modern, premium, editorial-style content.

I care about typography, spacing, composition, Reel pacing and the small details that make content feel polished.

I do NOT want generic Canva templates or the typical online-coach aesthetic.

Your portfolio will be one of the biggest factors in whether you're shortlisted.



YOU'LL BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU:

- Understand marketing, not just social media posting

- Understand hooks, buyer psychology and CTAs

- Have excellent written English

- Can write conversationally and match an existing brand voice

- Have strong visual/design judgement

- Can edit polished short-form video

- Are proactive and bring ideas

- Can work independently

- Notice details

- Understand that content should ultimately support business growth

- Are comfortable receiving ideas through voice notes/Loom rather than perfect briefs

- Use AI/ChatGPT intelligently without producing generic AI-sounding content



BONUS SKILLS

These are NOT required, but please tell me if you have experience with:

- Meta Ads

-
 marketing

- Landing-page optimisation

- Copywriting

- Funnels

- GoHighLevel

- Online courses/memberships

- Personal brands



I'd rather hire someone exceptional at content + marketing than someone average at 20 different things.



ROLE DETAILS

- Remote 

- Starting project-based

- Potential for an ongoing long-term position

- Flexible hours with reliable communication

- Paid trial for shortlisted candidates

- Start ASAP



HOW TO APPLY

Please send:

1. A short introduction about you.

2. Your portfolio.

3. Links to 2–3 social accounts, Reels, carousels or pieces of content you personally created. Tell me exactly what you were responsible for.

4. Your current availability.

5. Your expected hourly rate and/or preferred monthly rate.

6. Any experience you have with Meta Ads,
 marketing, funnels or landing pages.

7. Most importantly:



Send me one piece of marketing/content you've seen recently that you thought was brilliant and tell me WHY you think it worked.



Please don't send a generic copy/paste application.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a paid practical trial using real content from my business.

I'm looking for someone I can trust creatively, work closely with and hopefully keep around for a long time if we're a great fit.

title: Ecommerce Customer Support Representative
description:
Location: Remote (Philippines-based preferred)

Employment Type: Part-time (3 hrs/day, 7 days a week)

Rate: $5.00/hr

Schedule: 1 hour in the morning, 1 hour in the afternoon, 1 hour in the evening (exact times to be agreed upon hiring)



We're hiring urgently and reviewing applications on a rolling basis. Apply today if you're a good fit.



About the Role



We're a growing ecommerce team selling in the French market (with the UK market launching soon), looking for a dependable Customer Support Representative who can take ownership of customer concerns and see them through to resolution.



Our customers write mostly in French, so you'll respond to them primarily in French. You don't need to be a native French speaker — we provide ready-made templates and SOPs, and you're free to use translation tools (DeepL, ChatGPT) — but you must be comfortable reading, understanding, and replying to French messages accurately and professionally. Fluent written English is also required, as all internal communication with the founder, the team, and our suppliers happens in English.



Beyond customer-facing support, you'll also coordinate directly with our suppliers — for example to cancel or modify orders, request shipping updates, and chase tracking information — so customers always get accurate, up-to-date answers.



You'll work directly with the founder in a small team that values initiative, accountability, and clear communication.



This is a part-time role with a split schedule: you'll check in three times a day (morning, afternoon, and evening) for one hour each, every day of the week, including weekends. This keeps response times fast for our customers without requiring you to be online all day.



Who We're Looking For

At least 1–2 years of hands-on experience in direct-to-consumer (DTC) ecommerce customer support.

Ability to handle customer messages in French (with the help of templates and translation tools) — experience supporting French-speaking customers is a big plus.

Fluent written English for internal and supplier communication.

Experience handling orders, refunds, returns, and billing questions.

Experience communicating with suppliers or fulfillment agents (order changes, cancellations, tracking requests) is a strong plus.

Clear, warm, and professional written communication.

The ability to stay calm and empathetic when dealing with frustrated customers.

Confidence following standard operating procedures (SOPs) and working independently.

Familiarity with payment disputes and chargeback prevention.

Availability to work the fixed split schedule listed above (morning, afternoon, and evening check-ins), including weekends.

Interest in a stable, long-term position.



Previous DTC ecommerce support experience is required for this role.



Your Responsibilities

Respond to customer inquiries through
, social media comments, and direct messages — primarily in French, using our templates and SOPs.

Resolve questions about orders, shipping, delivery, products, and payments.

Process cancellations, refunds, returns, and exchanges according to company policies.

Communicate with our suppliers in English to cancel or modify orders, request shipping and tracking updates, and resolve fulfillment issues.

Handle complaints with care and provide clear next steps.

Manage payment disputes and flag potential chargeback risks.

Keep customer records accurate and escalate sensitive cases when needed.

Share recurring customer issues with the team to help improve the overall experience.

Support English-language customers as our UK market grows.

What We Offer

$5.00/hr

A stable, long-term remote role with a consistent daily schedule.

Clear processes, ready-made French templates, and a team that values your input.

Performance bonuses for consistent, quality work.

How to Apply



Fill out the application form: 



Please provide complete details and write your answers in your own words. AI-generated applications will be disqualified.



Only complete applications submitted through the form will be considered.

title: Creative Director
description:
LOCATION

Remote



ARRANGEMENT

Ongoing part-time retainer



HOURS

Approximately 10–15 hours per week, with flexible scheduling



COMPENSATION

$1,600–$2,400 USD per month, depending on experience and agreed scope





ABOUT SPIRITUS



Spiritus is an international initiative dedicated to renewing the great Catholic artistic and spiritual tradition through music, art, and sacred encounter.



We create performances, recordings, publications, and digital experiences that invite people to encounter beauty and open their hearts to the presence of God.



We are building a small, exceptional creative team to shape Spiritus’s visual identity, bringing imagination and artistry to projects of lasting spiritual and cultural value.





THE OPPORTUNITY



We are seeking a creative leader with significant experience in publications to shape Spiritus’s visual identity across its website, publications, video content, recording releases, and live events.



This is an opportunity to bring the richness of the Catholic artistic tradition into fresh contemporary expression, creating a visual language that draws people in and opens a space for sacred encounter.



You will lead and guide a small team of exceptional designers, with the trust and creative responsibility to carry ideas from first inspiration through to finished form.



An early centrepiece of the role will be an approximately 200-page, museum-quality art book documenting a sacred music project in France.





KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



- Establish Spiritus’s branding, design concepts, and visual guidelines from the outset, setting a coherent creative direction across the website, books, documents, recording packaging, YouTube, and other video content.



- Brief and guide the Book Designer and other specialist designers. Review and approve work within the agreed creative direction, while bringing major artistic decisions to Spiritus’s leadership.



- Shape publication structure, pacing, and visual storytelling. Recommend stronger imagery, writing, and contextual material where appropriate, and provide the Book Illustrator with precise editorial and visual feedback.



- Own publication delivery from concept through production. Coordinate contributors and printers, organise content and approvals, and manage schedules, revisions, credits, and final production checks.



- Anticipate potential problems, resolve routine questions independently, and keep the creative team moving with clear priorities and concise updates.



- Work closely with the operations lead to ensure team responsibilities, timelines, and delivery remain aligned.





QUALIFICATIONS



- At least 10 years of professional experience in design and art direction, with 20+ years strongly preferred.



- A proven record of creative leadership and the ability to establish and maintain a sophisticated visual direction.



- Exceptional visual taste and strong editorial judgment, demonstrated through high-quality illustrated publications or comparable creative projects you have helped lead.



- Ability to articulate creative decisions clearly, strengthen the work of other designers, and guide complex projects through production.



- Excellent English communication skills, independent problem-solving ability, and dependable follow-through.



- Sensitivity to Catholic sacred art and music, and an understanding of and respect for Spiritus’s mission.





WORKING ARRANGEMENT



This role is structured as an ongoing part-time retainer. The retainer reserves an agreed level of capacity and responsibility, and routine timesheets are not required.



During intensive publication periods, the workload may increase to approximately 20–25 hours per week. Any additional capacity and corresponding compensation will be agreed upon in advance.



The role will work closely with Spiritus’s operations lead to maintain clear responsibilities, priorities, and delivery across the creative team.





HOW TO APPLY



Please send your CV and portfolio, highlighting two or three relevant projects and clearly describing your role in each.



In your application, please briefly tell us:



1. What draws you to Spiritus and its mission.

2. How you would approach developing Spiritus’s visual identity.

3. Your current availability.

4. Your proposed monthly retainer.



Please
 your application to:







Use the role title in the subject line.



For a glimpse of our work, including Spiritus Editions and the international call for submissions to ILLUMINA, visit:



spiritus.art
