title: Book Designer
description:
BOOK DESIGNER



LOCATION

Remote



ARRANGEMENT

Freelance; initial book commission with potential for ongoing publication projects



HOURS

Approximately 35–40 hours per week during initial book production; variable thereafter



COMPENSATION

$25–$35 USD per hour, depending on experience and agreed scope





ABOUT SPIRITUS



Spiritus is an international initiative dedicated to renewing the great Catholic artistic and spiritual tradition through music, art, and sacred encounter.



We create performances, recordings, publications, and digital experiences that invite people to encounter beauty and open their hearts to the presence of God.



We are building a small, exceptional creative team to shape Spiritus’s visual identity, bringing imagination and artistry to projects of lasting spiritual and cultural value.





THE OPPORTUNITY



We are seeking an exceptional Book Designer to help shape an ambitious programme of publications of international cultural-institution quality, beginning with a classic approximately 200-page, museum-calibre art book documenting a sacred music project in France.



Familiarity with historic Catholic art is essential.



As the first in a continuing series of major publications, this book will help establish the standard for Spiritus’s publishing work. You will bring extraordinary visual judgment and a refined sense of storytelling to every page, creating publications that invite sustained attention and become objects to treasure.



Spiritus plans to produce multiple publications each year and is seeking a lasting creative collaboration with an outstanding designer.





KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



ART DIRECTION AND EDITORIAL DESIGN



- Develop the book’s visual language, typography, grids, chapter openings, cover, and recurring editorial elements within the Creative Director’s established visual direction.



- Shape the sequence, scale, and relationship of photography, artwork, manuscripts, musical scores, and writing with a refined sense of pacing and restraint.



- Personally execute the layouts in Adobe InDesign, incorporate feedback accurately, and maintain consistency throughout the publication.



- Establish a strong sense of hierarchy, rhythm, pacing, visual balance, and restraint across approximately 200 pages.





BOOK PRODUCTION



- Prepare and manage master pages, paragraph and character styles, grids, templates, image handling, and other production systems required for a substantial publication.



- Incorporate feedback accurately and efficiently while maintaining the integrity of the overall design.



- Manage revisions and ensure consistency across all chapters and recurring elements.



- Prepare final press-ready artwork and production files.



- Review colour proofs and support the production process through printing.



- Collaborate on paper stock, binding, finishes, colour reproduction, image quality, and other print-production decisions.



- Deliver well-organised, editable source files and associated production assets upon completion.





COLLABORATION



- Work closely with the Creative Director and Spiritus team throughout the design and production process.



- Participate in design reviews and clearly explain design decisions when required.



- Proactively identify design or production issues and propose thoughtful solutions.



- Work independently while communicating clearly with a small international remote team.





QUALIFICATIONS



- At least 10 years of professional experience in book and editorial design, with a proven record of delivering substantial illustrated publications to demanding production deadlines.



- A portfolio featuring outstanding art books, exhibition catalogues, photography books, museum publications, or similarly sophisticated publications that you personally designed.



- Exceptional typography, composition, visual storytelling, pacing, and attention to detail.



- Expert-level Adobe InDesign skills and strong working knowledge of relevant Adobe Creative Cloud applications.



- Strong practical knowledge of print production, including prepress, colour management, paper, binding, and finishes.



- Familiarity with historic Catholic art and the ability to work sensitively with sacred and historical material while creating a contemporary visual expression.



- Ability to work independently, manage a substantial publication, and meet demanding production deadlines.



- Strong communication and collaboration skills, particularly when working remotely with a small creative team.





WORKING ARRANGEMENT



The initial book requires approximately 35–40 hours per week during October, with printing planned for November, followed by preparation, proofing, and final production support as required.



Future projects may involve approximately 5–20 hours per week during active production periods. Some months may have no assignments.



This is intended to begin with a major book commission, with the potential to develop into an ongoing creative collaboration across future Spiritus publications.





HOW TO APPLY



Please send your CV and portfolio.



Your portfolio should include complete books or substantial consecutive page sequences wherever possible, rather than only individual spreads. Photographs of finished printed copies are also strongly encouraged.



For two or three relevant projects, please briefly explain:



1. Your role in the project.

2. What parts of the design and production you personally handled.

3. The publication size and approximate page count.

4. Your involvement in print production, if applicable.



Please also include:



- Your hourly rate.

- Your availability during the intensive October book-production period.

- A brief note on your experience working with art, cultural, museum, religious, or historically significant material.



Please
 your application to:







Use "Book Designer" in the subject line.



For a glimpse of our work, including Spiritus Editions and the international call for submissions to ILLUMINA, visit:



spiritus.art

```

title: Short Form Editor
description:
ASAP Marketing is a fast-paced social media and content agency working with brands across a variety of industries. We specialize in producing high-volume, engaging short-form content designed for platforms such as Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and other social channels.



We're looking for an experienced Short-Form Video Editor to join our growing creative team.



The Role



As a Short-Form Video Editor, you'll be responsible for turning raw footage, UGC, brand assets, and creative concepts into polished, engaging vertical videos.



You'll work closely with our Social Media Managers, UGC Coordinators, General Manager, and other members of our creative team to ensure content is edited accurately, efficiently, and delivered on schedule.



This is a high-volume editing position. Many of the videos we produce are relatively straightforward, but we work with multiple brands and produce a significant amount of content every month.



We're looking for someone who can maintain quality while working quickly, consistently, and efficiently.



Responsibilities



Edit high volumes of short-form vertical video content in 9:16 format

* Create content primarily for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts

* Turn raw footage and UGC into polished, social-ready video

* Coordinate with Social Media Managers and UGC Coordinators to ensure all necessary footage and assets are available

* Add captions, graphics, sound effects, music, transitions, B-roll, and other elements where appropriate

* Create strong hooks within the opening seconds of a video

* Understand and implement editing techniques designed to improve viewer retention and watch time

* Effectively use risers, pattern interrupts, pacing, sound design, cuts, zooms, B-roll, and visual hooks

* Maintain each client's individual editing style and brand identity

* Organize project files and exported content properly

* Complete revisions quickly when requested

* Manage multiple brands and projects simultaneously

* Consistently meet deadlines and expected editing output

* Communicate proactively with the team if footage, assets, instructions, or information are missing



What We're Looking For



Experience working for a social media agency, UGC agency, content agency, or with multiple brands simultaneously is a major advantage.



Editing Software



Experience with professional editing software such as:



* Adobe Premiere Pro

* DaVinci Resolve (Preferably DaVinci Resolve)



We're less concerned about which software you use and more concerned about the quality, speed, and consistency of your work.



What Success Looks Like:



This role is not about spending an entire day perfecting one video.



We operate in a high-volume environment, so the ideal editor understands how to balance quality with efficiency.



A successful editor at ASAP will be able to:



* Produce a high number of quality edits consistently

* Meet deadlines without sacrificing attention to detail

* Understand the intended style without excessive back-and-forth

* Identify opportunities to improve hooks, pacing, and retention

* Keep projects organized across multiple brands

* Communicate effectively with the rest of the content team

* Become faster and more efficient as they learn our clients and systems



How to Apply



**A portfolio is REQUIRED.**



Please submit:



1. Your portfolio or examples of previous short-form editing work

2. The editing software you primarily use

3. Your current availability

4. A short introduction Video explaining your experience with short-form social media editing and why you think you would be a good fit for our team



**Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.**



We're specifically interested in seeing examples of TikToks, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, UGC advertisements, talking-head videos, and other vertical short-form content.



If you're a fast, reliable editor who understands social media and enjoys producing great content at scale, we'd love to hear from you.

title: AI Video Creator
description:
We're not hiring someone to "make videos." We're hiring someone to move humans — to take the raw clay of footage, AI tools, and a story worth telling, and shape it into something that makes a stranger stop scrolling, lean in, and feel something real. Then act on it.





Who You Are 



You're a Storyteller First, Technologist Second. Anyone can prompt an AI tool. Almost nobody can tell a story that makes a CFO tear up at a B2B brand video. That's the gap we're hiring for.



You're Emotionally Intelligent — and It Shows in the Work. You can read a room, read a brief, and read a person's face on camera and know when they're holding back. You understand that great marketing isn't about being clever — it's about being true. You make people feel seen. That's the unfair advantage you bring.







- You're Motivated by Impact, Not Output. You don't measure your week in videos shipped. You measure it in whether the work moved someone — a customer, a candidate, a community. You'd rather make 10 videos that matter than 100 that don't.



- You Have Range. You can make us laugh on Tuesday and make us cry on Thursday. You can write a 15-second hook and a 6-minute brand film. You can shoot on an iPhone in a coffee shop and direct a polished studio piece.



You Move Fast Without Breaking Trust. You ship. You iterate. You don't disappear into perfectionism for three weeks. But you also don't publish anything you wouldn't be proud to sign your name to.



You're a Pro With AI — Not a Tourist. You've already built workflows nobody taught you. You know which tools are hype and which are durable. You know when to use AI and, more importantly, when not to.







Non-Negotiables



- Portfolio that makes us jealous. Show us the work. We'd rather see three pieces you're proud of than a sizzle reel of everything you've ever touched.

- 3+ years producing video for marketing or brand, ideally in a fast-moving environment where you weren't handed a 50-page brand book.

- Demonstrated AI fluency. You can walk us through a video you made where AI was central to the workflow — and explain the choices, including the human ones.

- Strong writing. If you can't write, you can't make great video. Period.

- You actually like people. This job involves real humans on camera. They'll feel how you feel about them.



The chance to build something. A team that takes the work seriously and themselves lightly. Direct line to leadership — your ideas get heard, your wins get noticed, your work goes out the door. Compensation that matches the talent we're looking for. And the rare gift of doing work you can point to in five years and say: that one mattered.

title: GTM Engineer
description:
You own the list. Not the application that displays it, not the outreach that goes out from it — **the list itself**, and the machinery that keeps it accurate, ranked, and fresh.



Why this role exists



We're a bootstrapped B2B services company. Our sharpest buying signal is a public event that tells us an account has just moved in-market — a 
nt when what we sell becomes urgent rather than interesting.



That signal is buried in third-party data feeds. Millions of records a week. Maybe two thousand matter to us.



Right now, finding those two thousand is guesswork wearing a lab coat. A query someone wrote once, a filter nobody has re-tuned since, and a number at the end that nobody can defend.



Your work is to make that number defensible, then make it bigger without making it worse.





What you'll own



1. The signal pipeline

Third-party data feeds ? filtered ? deduplicated ? scored ? landed in our database. You design the queries. You tune the filters. You own the credit budget and every coverage tradeoff inside it.



2. The account universe

Not just the inbound flow — the full stock of companies that could ever buy from us. Industry association directories, technographic sources, licensing registries, public company web sources. Feeds are rented. This asset is ours permanently.



3. The scoring model

Not every signal is equal. An account in our size band that just triggered our buying event is gold. An account that looks identical on paper but structurally cannot buy is noise, and noise is expensive because Sales spends real hours on it. You build the logic that separates them, and you revise it when Sales tells you it's wrong.



4. Enrichment

Company ? decision-maker ? verified contact. You own the waterfall, the match rates, and the cost per usable contact.



5. The truth

When someone asks "how many qualified signals did we get last week," you answer with a number you can walk backward to source. That sounds small. It's the entire role.







What you need to have done before



- Built and maintained a real B2B list pipeline — pulling from APIs, cleaning, deduplicating, enriching, shipping to a CRM or sequencer. Not a one-off extract. Something that ran daily and that people depended on.

- SQL, fluently. You can write the query that finds the duplicates.

- Python or equivalent for API work, pagination, rate limits, retries, and scheduled tasks.

- Worked with firmographic, technographic, or intent data providers — Apollo, Clay, ZoomInfo, People Data Labs, Bright Data, or similar. You know that a vendor's coverage claim and your actual result are two different numbers.

- Deduplication and entity resolution. Same company, four name variants, three domains. You've solved this at scale before.

- Cost discipline. You've operated inside a credit budget and made tradeoffs rather than just asking for a bigger plan.



What helps



- Exposure to B2B services, real estate, or professional services verticals

- Clay, Instantly, Supabase, or comparable tooling

- Technographic tools (BuiltWith, Wappalyzer)

- Comfort writing a short memo that says "our number is wrong, and here's why"



What this role is not



- Not a scraper-builder. We buy data where buying beats building. You'll need judgment about which is which, and the default answer is usually "buy."

- Not a full-stack developer. Engineering builds the product. You own the data moving through it.

- Not an SDR. You don't send the outreach. You make sure it reaches the right people.

- Not set-and-forget. The ICP moves. Vendors quietly change coverage. Filters rot. If you want to build something once and walk away, this will frustrate you.



---



How we'll measure it



- Qualified signals per week — and whether that number survives an audit

- Precision — Tier A accounts Sales agrees were worth a call

- Cost per qualified account

- Freshness — hours from signal appearing to account landing

- Duplicate rate — trending down, every month

title: Creative Strategist | Meta, TikTok & Instagram Ads [ECOM]
description:
Hey, we’re AmpX, a growing e-commerce brand based in Melbourne, Australia selling electric bike conversion kits, motors, batteries and accessories.



Website: 

TikTok + 



We’re looking for a sharp Creative Strategist to take ownership of the research, ideas and strategy behind our Meta, TikTok and Instagram content.



You do NOT need to be an advanced video editor or AI content creator.



This is a long-term role. We want someone who will grow with the brand for years and take on more responsibility as we scale.



WHAT THE JOB LOOKS LIKE DAY-TO-DAY



• Research competitors through Meta Ads Library, TikTok and Instagram

• Find winning ads, hooks, angles, offers and creative formats

• Research our customers, reviews, products and market

• Identify what content is getting views and what appears to be converting

• Stay on top of current advertising and social trends

• Develop hooks, scripts, concepts and creative briefs for our content creators

• Analyse our existing ads and identify what is working and what isn’t

• Come up with new variations and testing ideas based on winning creatives

• Work directly with our AI content creators and editors on what to produce next



You’ll use metrics like CTR, CPA, ROAS, hook rate, hold rate and watch time to guide your decisions.



The goal is simple: find what works, understand why it works and help us create more of it.



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



• Previous creative strategy or performance marketing experience

• Strong understanding of Meta Ads, TikTok and Instagram

• Strong knowledge of Meta Ads Library and competitor research

• Experience with DTC or e-commerce brands

• Understanding of direct-response advertising

• Strong understanding of hooks, angles and customer psychology

• Comfortable analysing creative performance data

• Strong written English and copywriting

• Able to turn research into clear briefs for content creators

• Able to work independently and bring us ideas instead of waiting for instructions



Previous experience in the e-bike or conversion kit space is highly regarded, but not required.



What matters most is your ability to quickly understand a new brand, its customers and competitors and figure out what content we should be creating.



PAY



$6-$12 USD/hr depending on experience + performance bonuses.



You’ll have a tracking sheet to log your hours and work completed. Payment is made at the end of each month.



Rates can increase as you prove yourself and take on more responsibility.



HOURS



Around Up to 6 hours per day, Up to 6 days per week depending on workload and results.



This is an output-focused role.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send:



• Your portfolio / why you’re a good fit

• Brands you have worked with

• Examples of ads or concepts you personally researched or strategised

• Results from previous campaigns where available

• How you normally research competitors and winning ads

• One thing you would improve after researching AmpX

• One ad angle you would test for AmpX and why

title: TikTok Operator (Shop & Account)
description:
[Read properly before applying]

[Do not apply if you do not meet the requirements or you do not possess the ample experience]

[This is NOT a VIDEO EDITOR job opening]

[This is NOT a CONTENT CREATOR job opening]

---



We're hiring a TikTok Operator to run and grow our U.S. TikTok Shop. This isn't a content or social media job — it's a business role. You'll own the whole channel: TikTok Shop, creators/affiliates, content, ads, livestreams, and the numbers behind all of it.



We want a builder! Someone who either launched a TikTok Shop from zero and made it succeed, or took over a shop that wasn't performing and turned it around. It needs to be *their* win — not a channel they just helped run while someone else called the shots.



You'll start hands-on, with room to build and lead a team as the channel grows.





JOB SPECIFICATIONS



[TikTok Business & Profitability]

- Understands how to grow TikTok sales while protecting margin, not just chasing GMV

- Good with numbers — can tell what's working, what's not, and what to scale or stop



[TikTok Shop Operations]

- Knows how TikTok Shop works — listings, pricing, promos, bundles, discount codes, store health



[Creators & Affiliates]

- Experience finding, recruiting, and managing TikTok creators and affiliates



[Content, Advertising & Livestream]

- Can guide short-form content strategy based on what performs well

- Familiar with TikTok Ads/Spark Ads and livestream operations



[Analytics & Reporting]

- Comfortable pulling together weekly performance updates and explaining the "why" behind the numbers



[Systems & Team Building]

- Can build simple SOPs/processes so the work runs smoothly as the team grows

- Open to eventually helping hire and manage a small supporting team





DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run the TikTok channel and grow its sales for the U.S. market

- Manage the TikTok Shop — product listings, pricing, promos, and store health

- Find, recruit, and manage TikTok creators and affiliates to promote products

- Plan and guide short-form video content based on what performs well

- Handle or oversee TikTok ads and livestreams

- Give weekly updates on sales, ads, creators, and content performance

- Create simple processes so the work can run smoothly as the team grows

- Strong English communication skills, written and verbal

- Can work independently, solve problems, and take full ownership of results





NON-NEGOTIABLES



- Based within Luzon, and willing to travel to NCR whenever the CEO is in Manila to check in with the team

- Was the main driver — not just a helper — behind a TikTok Shop's growth or launch. This means one of:

 [1] Launched a TikTok Shop from scratch and built it into a success (or at least got it to a strong state before leaving the company/client), or...

 [2] Took over a TikTok Shop with little to no traction (low sales/GMV) and turned it around

- Can clearly explain *their own* strategy and decisions behind that growth — not just point to results the shop achieved under someone else's plan

- Strong track record of driving measurable sales growth and improving overall TikTok channel performance

- Strong understanding of the TikTok Shop ecosystem and its key sales/growth drivers





NICE TO HAVE



- Background in health, wellness, beauty, personal care, supplements, medical products, sports, or other regulated consumer categories

- Experience managing TikTok at significant sales/GMV scale, or across multiple brands/shops

- Experience building or leading a TikTok/e-commerce team, or managing large creator networks

- Direct experience working with TikTok account managers or platform reps

- Experience managing TikTok alongside Amazon or other major e-commerce channels

title: Amazon Brand Manager
description:

[Do not apply if you dislike time trackers]

[Do not apply if you are far from NCR and nearby provinces]

JOB SUMMARY:

As our Amazon Brand Manager, you'll be the one steering how our products perform on Amazon day to day — from pricing and promotions to ad campaigns and everything in between. You'll keep an eye on our listings, spot opportunities to grow revenue, and help us stay ahead in our category.





RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Manage daily sales operations for assigned products, including pricing, promotions, and advertising campaigns

- Oversee product listings and identify new revenue opportunities within respective categories

- Monitor product performance to drive consistent sales growth and stronger category rankings

- Conduct in-depth product analysis and research market trends/competitors to guide strategic decisions

- Collaborate with the inventory planning team to manage promotions and excess inventory

- Ensure accuracy, timeliness, and confidentiality across all deliverables





QUALIFICATIONS:

• Strong brand management experience — from listing optimization and A+ Content to product launches and brand positioning

• PPC experience is a plus, but not required

• Strong analytical, data-driven decision-making skills

• Solid market research experience

• Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal)

• Strong documentation and time management skills





NON-NEGOTIABLE REQUIREMENTS:

• This role is strictly for applicants based within NCR or nearby areas (e.g., Bulacan, Rizal).

• You'll need to send a portfolio with a real ASIN you've personally handled from launch to finish (brand/product can be blurred), backed by substantial data — think sales or bestseller ranking graphs, not just a screenshot. If NDA-restricted or you no longer have account access, a short video walkthrough explaining the work and results is acceptable instead.

• Be ready to walk through and explain the actual performance data behind that ASIN during the interview — conversion rate, ACOS, organic vs. paid sales split. This will be a substantial part of the conversation, so come prepared to speak to real numbers, not general claims.





SETUP:

• Uses Time Doctor for time tracking

• Stable internet connection, with a readily available backup connection

• Full-time contractual employment (renewal contract based on performance)

• There will be quarterly (with chances of it being monthly) meet-ups within NCR whenever the CEO visits the Philippines

title: Social Media Manager - Ecommerce Fashion Brand
description:
Hello! We are a growing UK women’s ecommerce fashion brand looking for an experienced Social Media Manager to take day-to-day ownership of our organic social media.



This is a hands-on ecommerce role for someone who has already managed social media for a real ecommerce, DTC or product-based business.



We already have product photography, lifestyle photography, UGC, creator content and finished video available. Your job is to take those assets and turn them into strong, finished social content: choose what to use, d
 how to use it, write the copy, create simple supporting graphics where needed, schedule/publish the content and keep our social channels active, current and commercially useful.



You will also support the final preparation of paid-social ads such as writing or adapting copy and, where experienced, uploading approved ads into Meta Ads Manager ready for review.



We are hiring for strong ecommerce social-media experience, judgement, copywriting and execution. This is a long-term role of approximately 35 hours per week and should be your primary working commitment.



WHAT YOU’LL OWN

1. Organic Social Media

- You will take day-to-day ownership of our social content across
, Instagram and TikTok.

- Own and maintain the social-media content calendar

- Choose the strongest content from our existing photography, UGC, creator content and finished video

- Plan what should be posted and when

- Write captions, hooks, promotional copy and calls to action

- Schedule and publish content consistently

- Create Stories, carousels, product posts, promotional posts, customer review content, polls, reposts and other native social content

- Adapt content appropriately for each platform rather than simply posting exactly the same thing everywhere

- Repurpose strong existing assets in new ways without making the feed feel repetitive

- Keep channels current, active and on-brand

- Respond naturally to comments and community activity

- Escalate order, refund or customer-service issues to the appropriate team

- Identify posts and formats that perform particularly well and share useful learnings with the founders

- We want someone who can take an asset from folder to finished social post, rather than waiting for completed posts to be handed to them.



2. Canva & Simple Content Adaptation

You should be confident using Canva or similar tools for high-quality everyday social execution, including:

- Stories and carousels

- Adding offers, reviews, prices, headlines or calls to action to existing photography

- Adapting existing templates or working from an example image

- Resizing and cropping content correctly for different placements

- Creating simple promotional or product-led social graphics

- Maintaining consistent branding and good visual presentation



3. Social Content Planning & Research

We want someone proactive who can take campaign priorities, seasonal launches and existing content ideas and turn them into a strong, well-planned social calendar while also contributing useful ideas of their own.

- Research strong social content from ecommerce, fashion and consumer brands

- Monitor Instagram, TikTok,
, Pinterest and relevant trends

- Identify useful hooks, formats, content ideas and approaches we could adapt

- Explain why an idea could work for our brand rather than simply saving examples

- Identify gaps in our existing content, for example products lacking suitable lifestyle photography, UGC, reviews or video

- Help us make better use of the large amount of content we already have

- Keep launches, promotions and key dates planned ahead



4. Paid Social Execution Support

This is a supporting and executional responsibility only. You will not be responsible for paid-media strategy, campaign budgets or overall Meta performance.

- Take approved photography, UGC or finished video and prepare it for paid-social use

- Write or adapt primary text, headlines, calls to action and promotional wording

- Ensure the correct creative, offer, URL and CTA are being used

- Where experienced, upload approved ads into Meta Ads Manager using supplied structures and naming conventions

- Prepare ads ready for founder/media-buyer review before launch where required

- Spot strong organic posts, UGC or creator content that may be worth testing as paid advertising

- Previous Meta Ads Manager uploading experience is strongly preferred but not essential if you have excellent ecommerce social experience and are comfortable learning the executional process.



ESSENTIAL EXPERIENCE

Please only apply if you meet the following requirements:

- Previous professional experience personally managing day-to-day social media for a real ecommerce, DTC or product-based business

- Experience managing
 and Instagram for a brand

- Evidence of real ecommerce accounts and content you have personally worked on

- Experience planning posts, choosing assets, writing captions, scheduling/publishing and managing ongoing social activity

- Experience taking supplied photography, UGC or video and turning it into finished social content

- Strong written English and the ability to write natural, engaging copy

- Good visual judgement and the ability to recognise which assets are strongest

- Comfortable using Canva for social-media content

- Good understanding of how social supports ecommerce launches, promotions, product discovery and sales

- Strong organisation across content calendars, assets and deadlines

- Able to work independently, make sensible day-to-day decisions and bring ideas without constant supervision

- Able to commit approximately 35 hours per week as your primary working role



STRONGLY PREFERRED

- Fashion, apparel, activewear, beauty, accessories or other visually led ecommerce experience

- Experience creating content for a UK, US or Australian audience

- Experience writing paid-social primary text, headlines and CTAs

- Basic Shopify familiarity

- Meta Ad Library or creative-research experience

- Basic understanding of ecommerce/social metrics such as engagement, reach, CTR, CPA, CVR and ROAS



PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF:

- Your social-media experience is mainly real estate, coaches, personal brands, restaurants or other service businesses and you have not also managed ecommerce/product brands

- Most of your portfolio consists of AI-generated graphics, fictional brands, concept campaigns or mock work

- You have never personally managed the day-to-day social media of a real ecommerce or product business

- You are looking to move into ecommerce for the first time

- You primarily specialise in photography or filming content

- You are looking to combine this role with another full-time position

- We are completely comfortable with sensible use of AI as a working tool, but AI-generated imagery or AI-created portfolio work will not be accepted as evidence of ecommerce social media experience.



THE PERSON WE’RE LOOKING FOR

- You are someone who enjoys actually running social media, not simply designing graphics for it.

- You can look through a folder containing 30 photographs and quickly identify the strongest few.

- You can take a good product photograph, piece of UGC or finished video and know how to package it differently for
, Instagram, TikTok or Pinterest.

- You can write a caption that sounds natural rather than generic or obviously AI-generated.

- You notice when a promotion is approaching, content is running low or an important product has not been featured recently.

- You care about creative that gets attention, engagement, clicks and sales, not simply content that looks pretty.

- And importantly, you understand the pace and commercial priorities of an ecommerce business.



HOW TO APPLY

Please include:

1. Your CV (Please clearly highlight the ecommerce, DTC or product-based brands you have worked with).



2. Real social accounts you have managed

Send links to 1–2 real ecommerce/product brand social-media accounts you have personally worked on. For each account, tell us:

- How long you worked on it

- Exactly what you personally handled

- Which platforms you managed

- Any success stories using actual numbers (eg. change in engagement / follower count / etc)



3. Show us three posts you personally worked on

Choose three real examples and explain what you did for each.



We also recommend sending a short Loom video, ideally 2–3 minutes maximum, introducing yourself and briefly talking us through one real ecommerce account you have managed. This is a great way to stand out from other applicants.

Please include the word “alpaca” somewhere in your application so we know you have read the full job description.



HIRING PROCESS

Stage 1: CV, real-account examples and application review

Stage 2: Short practical assessment using photography, UGC and finished content supplied by us

Stage 3: Video interview

Final stage: Short paid trial before continuing long term if we are all happy



For the practical assessment, candidates will work with real supplied assets. We are not looking for AI-generated imagery or stock photography.

We're looking for someone reliable, curious, and hard-working — not someone with a perfect CV. The starting salary is $300, with increases and performance-based incentives as you build skills and take on more responsibilities (e.g., Our best VAs are doing $
per month).

title: Short-Form Video Editor (CapCut) - UK Client, Long Term, 10 Videos/Week
description:
Short-Form Video Editor (CapCut) - UK Businesses - Long Term, Room To Grow



I run a few businesses in the UK and I'm hiring one editor to handle all the short-form video across them. Not an agency, no clients, no account managers. You'd be working directly with me.



The three brands:



A premium garden design and landscaping company in Leicestershire, selling high-end garden builds to homeowners.



A reformer Pilates studio, selling memberships and classes locally.



My personal brand on business coaching, where I talk about growing a business, hiring, systems and the realities of running several companies at once. The audience is other business owners, so the tone is punchier and more direct than the other two.



Three audiences, three tones, one standard. This is a long-term role, not a one-off gig.



The work



Minimum 10 videos per week: 4 landscaping, 3 Pilates, 3 business coaching. Most run 30 to 60 seconds, vertical 9:16, built for Instagram Reels.



The landscaping and coaching content is mostly talking head footage of me. The coaching videos in particular live or die on the first three seconds, so you'll need a feel for where the hook sits and how hard to cut into it.



You'll get a Google Drive folder with the raw footage plus a separate folder of b-roll (finished gardens, builds in progress, drone shots, studio footage). I'll give you the topic and the angle for each video.



Your job: cut the talking head so it flows naturally, strip out pauses, mistakes and retakes, lay the right b-roll over the right moments, add music, add subtitles styled to feel native to Instagram, finish with the end card.



Where the footage doesn't cover something, I want you generating AI clips to bridge the gap and hold the story together. That matters most on the coaching content, where there's less usable b-roll to fall back on. If you haven't done this before, say so honestly. I'd rather teach the right person than hire the wrong one.



These videos exist to bring in enquiries. Hook, pacing and clarity beat effects every time.



Tools



You must be fluent in CapCut. That's what we edit in. Comfort with an AI video generation tool is a strong plus.



Pay



£14 per finished minute of edited video (roughly $18 USD). At the minimum of 10 videos a week at around 60 seconds each, that's about £140/$186 a week, roughly £600/$800 a month, paid monthly via Western Union or PayPal.



Volume goes up as the businesses grow, and so does your income.



Where this goes



I'm launching a YouTube channel soon for the landscaping brand, starting with short YouTube videos, and that becomes part of this role. Longer edits, different pacing, thumbnails and titles to think about.



Beyond that, for the right person: social media planning, content calendars and scheduling across all three brands. If you want to grow into running the content side rather than staying an editor forever, tell me that in your application.



Who this suits



You edit short-form vertical video and you're good at it. You have taste. You can follow a detailed brief closely and still make sensible creative calls inside it. You hit deadlines without being chased. Your written English is clear enough that I can brief you in writing and trust it lands.



I'm in the UK, 7 hours behind the Philippines. Work whatever hours suit you as long as the videos land on time. I'll need you contactable a few hours a week in your evening for calls.



How to apply



Use 10 apply points.



Start your application with the words FROSTED STEMS. Applications without this are deleted unread.



Then send me:



Links to 3 short-form vertical videos you personally edited, and for each one a sentence on what you actually did (edit only, or edit plus captions plus motion). Be honest about your role on each.



Which editing tools you use day to day, and whether you've used AI video generation.



How many hours a week you currently have free.



Your Instagram handle or portfolio, if you have one.



Shortlisted applicants will be asked to complete a trial task: one real 60 second edit from my actual footage, 2 to 3 hours of work, submitted within 72 hours. I'm hiring within one week of this post going live.

title: Appoinment Setter
description:
We sell AI services to small contractors in the United States — pool builders, fencing companies, HVAC and roofing crews. These are one- and two-man businesses that lose work every day to problems automation solves, starting with missed calls: the owner is on a job site, the phone rings, and the job goes to whoever picked up.



We're hiring one appointment setter to call these owners and book a 30-minute consultation. You are not closing sales. You book the meeting, our team handles the rest.



Responsibilities



Make 200 outbound calls per shift from a provided list of licensed business owners with direct contact numbers

Deliver a short pitch and handle common objections

Book qualified 30-minute appointments into our calendar

Log call outcomes accurately and report your numbers at the end of each shift

What we provide



A US phone number through Dialpad — no equipment purchase needed

A verified lead list. No cold databases, no gatekeepers — you have the owner's name and direct line before you dial.

Script, objection handling guide, and training

Schedule



Monday to Friday, 12:00 AM – 9:00 AM Philippine time (US Pacific business hours)

Permanent night shift, permanent work from home

Compensation



This is a base salary plus uncapped commission, paid in US dollars.



Base: USD $500 per month. Guaranteed, regardless of results. Paid twice a month — on the 15th and the 30th — through Wise, which lands directly in your GCash. You get paid every two weeks like a normal job, not once a month in arrears.



Commission: 5% of every deal that closes. When an appointment you booked turns into a paying client, you get 5% of the setup fee — USD $50 on our standard package, USD $100 on the premium one. There is no cap. Five closed deals in a month is an extra $250–500 on top of your base.



You don't close the sale yourself — our closers do that. Your job is to book the meeting and get the owner to actually show up. Commission is paid on the payout cycle after the client's first payment clears.



Requirements



No calling experience required. We care more about how you sound on the phone and whether you can take rejection than where you've worked.

Clear, neutral English speaking voice

Able to commit to a permanent night shift, 12 AM – 9 AM PHT

Reliable internet (10 Mbps minimum)

Resilient — this role involves constant rejection

How to apply



Applications without a Loom are not reviewed.



Record one Loom (free at loom.com), camera on, two minutes maximum, and answer these in the video:



What's your name and where in the Philippines are you based?

What are you doing right now — are you working, and what are you earning?

Can you commit to 12:00 AM – 9:00 AM Philippine time, Monday to Friday, permanently?

Have you worked a night shift before? How long, and why did you leave the last one?

Why do you think you'd be a great fit for this specific role?

What's your experience — whatever it actually is? No calling background required. If you've never made a cold call, say so straight and tell us what you have done that transfers.

What's the best number you've ever produced — sales, calls, appointments, customers? What did you do to get it?

Give us numbers, not adjectives.



Loom links only — your link must start with loom.com.

and alerting

engineering, and business stakeholders

title: We are looking for an experienced accountant or bookkeeper to help us organize and document all of the financial liabili
description:
We are looking for an experienced accountant or bookkeeper to help us organize and document all of the financial liabilities and obligations related to our e-commerce business.



Our business operates across multiple jurisdictions, so we need someone who can help us build a clear system showing what we owe, where we owe it, when payments or filings are due, and what documentation needs to be maintained.



The main goal of this project is organization and visibility. We want to create a central document and folder structure where all liabilities, supporting documents, deadlines, and jurisdiction-specific requirements can be easily tracked.



Responsibilities will include:



* Review our current business structure, accounts, transactions, and existing records.

* Identify and categorize liabilities such as taxes, VAT/GST/sales tax, corporate obligations, accounts payable, loans, credit cards, fees, and other outstanding obligations.

* Organize liabilities by company/entity and jurisdiction.

* Create a master spreadsheet or document showing amounts owed, due dates, status, responsible entity, jurisdiction, and supporting documentation.

* Create an organized folder structure for invoices, tax documents, government notices, payment confirmations, accounting records, and related files.

* Help identify missing information or records we need to collect.

* Flag upcoming deadlines, overdue obligations, and areas that may require attention from a local accountant or tax professional.

* Help establish a process that can be maintained going forward.



Our business is primarily e-commerce, so experience with online businesses, international transactions, payment processors, marketplaces, sales tax/VAT, and multi-country operations is highly preferred.



We are looking for someone who is extremely organized, detail-oriented, comfortable working with incomplete or messy financial records, and able to turn them into a clear and structured system.



When applying, please include:



1. Your experience with e-commerce businesses.

2. Your experience handling businesses operating across multiple jurisdictions.

3. Which countries/jurisdictions you are familiar with.

4. Whether you have experience with sales tax, VAT/GST, corporate tax obligations, and cross-border transactions.

5. An example of how you would structure a master liabilities tracker for this type of business.

6. **A short video, no longer than 2 minutes, introducing yourself and telling us why you think you would be a good fit to work with us.** Please include a link to the video at the end of your application.



Applications without the short video may not be considered.



This could become an ongoing bookkeeping/accounting role if the initial organization project goes well.

s professionally and quickly

But you DO need to be highly skilled with Claude and understand enough about e-commerce marketing, direct response, customers, ads, and copy to use Claude effectively.



We are looking for someone who uses Claude as a serious working tool - not someone who occasionally asks AI to "write 
 ads."



If you are constantly experimenting with Claude, building better prompts and workflows, feeding it research and context, and figuring out how to get significantly better outputs from AI, we want to hear from you.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



You will use Claude heavily for our e-commerce marketing operation.

* Using Claude for customer research

* Finding customer pain points, desires, objections, and buying triggers

* Researching competitors and their advertising

* Using Claude to find patterns and insights in large amounts of information

* Developing ad angles and hooks

* Helping create direct response ad copy

* Creating creative briefs for our video and static ad creators

* Analyzing existing ads and finding new iteration opportunities

* Turning raw information into useful marketing insights

* Organizing research and context inside Claude

* Improving prompts, instructions, and AI workflows

* Building repeatable Claude workflows for our marketing team

* Finding new ways to use AI to make our marketing operation faster and better



You will work together with other people in our marketing team.



You do NOT need to edit videos or design ads yourself.



CLAUDE IS THE MOST IMPORTANT PART OF THIS ROLE



We are specifically looking for someone who already has significant hands-on experience with Claude.



We want someone who understands that great AI output depends on great input, context, instructions, research, and workflows.



You should know how to:



* Give Claude large amounts of useful context

* Structure information before asking for output

* Work with long documents and research

* Analyze large amounts of customer feedback

* Create strong prompts and reusable workflows

* Iterate on outputs instead of accepting the first answer

* Get Claude to follow specific marketing frameworks and instructions

* Use Claude for research, analysis, copy, ideation, and problem-solving

* Reduce generic "AI-sounding" output

* Build repeatable systems instead of starting from zero every time



We are NOT looking for someone whose AI experience is limited to basic prompting.



We want a real Claude power user.



MARKETING EXPERIENCE



You should have some previous experience or strong knowledge of:



* E-commerce

* Digital marketing

* Direct response marketing

* Meta/TikTok advertising

* Customer psychology

* Ad copy

* Hooks and angles

* Paid social creatives



You do NOT need to be an expert in every area.



We care more about finding someone who is exceptional with Claude and has enough marketing knowledge to understand what good marketing looks like.



Experience working with e-commerce/DTC brands is highly preferred.



WHO THIS ROLE COULD BE PERFECT FOR



You might be:



* An AI/Claude power user working in marketing

* An AI Marketing Specialist

* An E-commerce Marketer who became obsessed with AI

* A Copywriter who uses Claude extensively

* A Marketing VA with advanced AI skills

* A Junior Creative Strategist with exceptional Claude skills

* Someone who has built their own Claude marketing workflows and systems



Your exact job title doesn't matter.



We care about what you can actually do with Claude.



WHAT WE CARE ABOUT MOST



We want someone who:



* Uses Claude every day or very frequently

* Loves experimenting with AI

* Knows how to get high-quality outputs from Claude

* Can work independently

* Learns extremely fast

* Thinks logically

* Understands marketing fundamentals

* Is comfortable working with large amounts of information

* Can turn research into useful marketing output

* Constantly looks for better and faster ways of working

* Doesn't need step-by-step instructions for everything



We want someone who thinks:



"How can I use Claude to do this better?"



COMPENSATION & PERFORMANCE BONUSES



The base rate for this position is $3-$8 USD per hour, depending on your experience, Claude skill level, marketing knowledge, and track record.



We strongly believe in rewarding performance.



If your work helps us improve our marketing, find winning creatives, increase output, or build systems that save the team significant time, we are happy to pay additional performance-based bonuses on top of your hourly rate.



The better you perform and the more value you bring to the business, the more you can earn.



We are looking for someone who wants to work with us long term and grow together with the company.



HOW TO APPLY

IMPORTANT - PLEASE ANSWER THESE QUESTIONS

PLEASE NOTE



Claude experience is more important to us than having a senior marketing background.

If you have strong marketing experience but only basic Claude experience, this role is probably not the right fit.

title: Static Ads Designer (Graphic Designer) - Meta / Facebook Ads
description:
STATIC ADS DESIGNER (GRAPHIC DESIGNER) - META /
 ADS



Remote | Full-Time | $1,500-$2,000/mo + bonuses on every winning ad



We're a new health and wellness supplement brand, built by a founder who has already scaled a brand to eight figures.



We grow through Meta ads. Static ads are a big part of that, and we're hiring our first graphic designer: someone whose whole job is making them.



You'll build 10-15 ad concepts a week from our creative strategist's briefs. Once those are done, you can make your own ads too. If they win, you get paid for them.



==============================

WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT

==============================



YOU GET PAID WHEN YOUR ADS WIN

$250 for every winning ad from a brief. 1.5% of ad spend on your own winning ads, for as long as they run.



YOU'LL GET BETTER FAST

40-60 of your ads go live every month with real spend data. You'll learn what actually sells in weeks, not years.



YOU GET CREATIVE FREEDOM

We like bold ideas. We're not a brand that says no to everything.



WE TEACH YOU CREATIVE STRATEGY

Prompts, training and paid courses, so your own ads win more often.



YOUR OWN IDEAS GET LAUNCHED

Most design jobs only let you build other people's ideas. Here, once your briefs are done, you can make your own ads and we'll run them with real budget.



YOUR WINS GET NOTICED

Small team, so good work doesn't get buried.



==============================

WHAT YOU'LL DO

==============================



— Build 10-15 static ad concepts a week from strategist briefs, on time

— Get most concepts right in one round of revisions or less

— Turn around ad hoc visuals (product page images, site graphics) within 48 hours

— Make your own ads once your weekly briefs are done



You'll report to our Creative Strategist.



==============================

HOW WE MEASURE YOU

==============================



Main goal: winning ads per month.



We also track:



— Concepts shipped per week

— On-time delivery

— Revision rounds per concept

— Hit rate (how many of your ads become winners)



==============================

GROWTH

==============================



The next step is Senior Graphic Designer: hiring, training and managing other designers once the team grows.



Leadership is optional. If you'd rather stay a specialist and just get really good at design, that's fine too.



==============================

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

==============================



MUST-HAVE EXPERIENCE



— 1+ year designing static ads for ecommerce brands (Meta or other paid social)

— A portfolio of static ads you personally made. Brand or web work alone doesn't show you can make ads.

— Strong in Photoshop, Figma or similar

— Good spoken and written English. Briefs and feedback are written, and you'll be on calls with the team.

— Reliable internet and your own computer



MUST-HAVE TRAITS



— You take feedback without ego and apply it the first time

— You work fast without the quality dropping

— You know what makes an ad stop the scroll: clear hierarchy, easy to read on a phone

— You use AI image tools and keep up as they change

— You communicate clearly: you confirm briefs, ask questions before starting, and flag problems the same day

— You want to keep getting better at your craft



==============================

WHAT WE DON'T CARE ABOUT

==============================



— Motion or video editing

— Pixel-perfect polish. Speed and testing beat perfection here.

— A design degree

— Being charismatic on calls



==============================

THIS ISN'T FOR YOU IF

==============================



— You want to keep other clients or freelance on the side. This is full-time with us only.

— You can't be online 3-5pm LA (Pacific) time every weekday

— You get defensive when your work gets feedback

— You don't want to use AI tools



==============================

HOW WE WORK

==============================



— Post your daily priorities in a shared channel

— Get direct feedback often, including from the founder

— Give feedback upward too

— Work from written briefs and ask questions async

— Weekly calls with the creative team

— Strategist briefs come first, then ad hoc requests, then your own ads

— Flag a slipping deadline before it's missed, not after



==============================

PAY

==============================



— $1,500 - $2,000 USD per month, depending on experience

— $250 for every winning ad from a strategist brief

— 1.5% of ad spend on your own winning ads, for as long as they keep hitting our targets



For example: 2 winning ads from briefs in a month is $500. One of your own ads spending $50k that month adds $750. That's $1,250 on top of base. This is an example, not a guarantee.



==============================

BENEFITS

==============================



— 20 days paid time off

— Fully remote

— Flexible hours outside the daily overlap

— Paid courses that improve your design or ad-making

— AI tools and software paid for



==============================

HOURS

==============================



— Full-time

— Online 3-5pm LA (Pacific) time every weekday. That's early morning in Asia and afternoon in Latin America. Outside that, set your own schedule. We care about output, not hours logged.

— Open to candidates anywhere in the world



==============================

HOW TO APPLY

==============================



1) Fill out the application form: 

2) Screening call

3) Work History Interview

4) Design assessment

5) Final interview

6) Reference calls



Ready to get paid for every winning ad, see your work run with a real budget every week, and learn what actually makes ads sell? We're reviewing applications on a rolling basis and will close the role once it's filled. Apply now.

title: CREATIVE STRATEGIST: ECOMMERCE META ADS, SWIPES AND WINNING ANGLES
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



We are a health, beauty, and wellness ecommerce company running Meta ads across multiple international stores.



We are looking for an experienced Creative Strategist who can research strong swipes, develop original angles, write direct-response copy, and guide Image Ad Creators in producing effective static ads.



This is not a general social media or graphic-design position. You must understand ecommerce advertising, customer psychology, direct-response creative strategy, and how to turn research into concepts that can be tested and scaled.



## WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Research competitor ads, product pages, advertorials, reviews, customer pain points, and market trends.

- Find strong swipes using the Meta Ad Library and other reliable research sources.

- Evaluate swipes using signals such as reach, impressions, run duration, repetition, market relevance, and advertiser credibility.

- Turn research into original angles, hooks, offers, ad copy, and detailed creative briefs.

- Guide Image Ad Creators and review whether their work follows the intended strategy.

- Create new concepts instead of repeatedly redesigning the same angle.

- Develop iterations of proven winners without losing the reason the original ad worked.

- Review performance with the media-buying team and use the results to plan the next concepts.

- Maintain an organized testing pipeline across assigned products and stores.

- Follow Meta compliance requirements for health, beauty, and wellness advertising.

- Report creative winners, failures, learnings, and next actions clearly.



## WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- Proven Creative Strategist experience with ecommerce or dropshipping brands.

- Strong swipe-research and direct-response thinking.

- Able to explain why an ad may be working and how to turn that insight into an original concept.

- Strong understanding of angles, hooks, offers, customer awareness, and advertorial funnels.

- Comfortable writing ad copy and giving clear instructions to designers.

- Able to use performance data to d
 what to iterate, stop, or replace.

- Familiar with Meta compliance risks involving health and beauty products.

- Available full time and interested in long-term work.



## NICE TO HAVE



- Experience with health, beauty, wellness, supplements, or personal-care products.

- Experience with UK, EU, Canada, Israel, Switzerland, or US markets.

- Experience writing advertorials, product pages, or offer pages.

- Experience leading designers or a small creative pod.

- A portfolio containing ads or angles that achieved measurable results.



## HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word **ANGLE**.



Answer every question below. General or incomplete answers may not be considered.



1. How many years have you worked as a Creative Strategist for ecommerce or dropshipping brands?

2. Which products, niches, brands, and markets have you worked with?

3. Walk us through your complete swipe-research process.

4. What performance signals do you use to d
 whether a swipe is worth studying?

5. Share one winning angle you developed. Explain the research, insight, execution, and result.

6. How do you turn a competitor swipe into an original concept instead of copying it?

7. Have you written ad copy, advertorials, or landing pages? Please share examples.

8. How do you use campaign data when d
 what to iterate, stop, or replace?

9. What Meta compliance risks do you watch for in health and beauty advertising?

10. Have you led designers or Image Ad Creators? Describe your briefing and feedback process.

11. Share your CV, portfolio, sample briefs, swipe boards, landing pages, and any redacted performance evidence.

12. State your availability or earliest start date.

13. State your expected monthly salary in USD.



Qualified applicants will be invited to complete a Creative Strategist assessment.

title: Operations Coordinator / Sales Operations Support
description:

title: Long & Short-Form Video Editor
description:
About the Role



We are a fast-growing wellness brand rethinking the traditional protein bar — an all-natural, whole-food protein bar using clean, recognizable ingredients. As the brand expands across retail, our founders are documenting the behind-the-scenes journey of building the business — from travelling across the US and supporting retail launches to demos, events, and everyday startup life.



We're looking for a Long & Short-Form Video Editor to turn that raw footage into engaging, story-driven content. This role will primarily focus on editing long-form YouTube-style content, supported by short-form edits for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and the founders' personal social channels.



You'll receive raw footage from the founders and be responsible for turning it into polished, engaging content that captures the personality, energy, and reality of building a fast-growing consumer brand. We're looking for someone who is more than a technical editor — you should understand storytelling, pacing, humour, hooks, and retention, and be able to identify the moments within hours of footage that are actually worth watching.



Work Structure & Requirements



Location: Remote / Virtual

Schedule: Part-time (20 hours per week)

Time Zone: EST business hours

Compensation: 8 USD per hour

Key Responsibilities



1. Long-Form Video Editing



Edit raw founder footage into engaging YouTube-style episodes, typically around 15–25 minutes

Review several hours of raw footage and identify the strongest moments, storylines, and narrative arcs

Turn loosely structured footage into cohesive, entertaining stories

Cut unnecessary material while maintaining natural pacing and personality

Add music, sound effects, text, graphics, subtitles, and other elements where appropriate

Handle basic colour correction, audio cleanup, and overall visual consistency

Create strong openings and hooks that encourage viewers to continue watching

Incorporate B-roll and supporting footage to strengthen storytelling

Manage revisions and deliver polished final edits on schedule

2. Short-Form Content



Turn long-form footage and standalone clips into TikToks, Instagram Reels, and other vertical content

Identify short moments that can work independently as compelling social content

Edit clips with strong hooks, captions, pacing, and platform-native formatting

Create content for both the brand and the founders' personal accounts

Develop teasers and cutdowns that help drive audiences toward longer YouTube content

Repurpose existing footage efficiently to maximise the value of each shoot

3. Content & Editing Workflow



Organise raw footage, project files, and completed assets in a clear and repeatable system

Maintain consistent editing styles, fonts, graphics, and visual treatments

Work closely with the founders to understand their preferred style and continuously refine it

Manage multiple videos at different stages of the editing process

Proactively suggest opportunities to turn existing footage into additional content

Stay current with editing styles and content trends across YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram

Required Skills & Experience



Experience: 3+ years of professional video editing experience

Portfolio: Strong portfolio demonstrating both long-form and short-form editing; experience editing YouTube, documentary-style, vlog, founder-led, or behind-the-scenes content

Storytelling: Strong understanding of storytelling, pacing, and audience retention; ability to take several hours of raw footage and independently determine what should make the final cut

Short-Form: Excellent short-form editing instincts for TikTok and Instagram Reels

Technical: Proficiency with Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar professional editing software; comfortable with captions, motion graphics, sound design, and basic colour correction

Organisation: Highly organised and able to manage large volumes of footage

Communication: Excellent written and spoken English; able to work independently with limited direction

Bonus: Experience editing content for CPG, food, wellness, fitness, or lifestyle brands; experience editing founder-led YouTube series or startup/build-in-public content; basic motion graphics or After Effects experience; YouTube thumbnail design; familiarity with YouTube retention analytics; experience repurposing long-form content into multiple short-form assets



To Apply:

Kindly send your resume, portfolio and introduction video

 templates – the Creative Director remains the primary client contact.

About You

You're a capable, mid-level graphic designer who also loves bringing order to a busy creative environment. You're organised, reliable and comfortable taking ownership of your role without needing to be chased. You are comfortable working in an environment where priorities can shift and your week's mix of design, admin and marketing tasks will vary. Experience in a creative agency or corporate team environment is highly valued, and you understand how creative agencies operate.



You MUST have your own safe, private and distraction-free home office with a reliable computer, stable high-speed internet and stable power.



Experience & Skills

Personal Attributes

● Systems-minded – naturally documents and improves how things work

Important note:

Please only apply if you feel this role genuinely aligns with your CV and experience – if this role feels like too much of a “stretch” for you and doesn't align with your skillset or experience, please do not apply. description:
Finance & Bookkeeping Officer – Australian Sportswear Company



Part-Time → Full-Time Opportunity | Remote – Philippines



An established Australian sportswear company is seeking an experienced Finance & Bookkeeping Officer to join our team remotely from the Philippines.



This is initially a part-time position of approximately 20 hours per week, with a strong focus on improving internal financial processes, managing accounts receivable, cleaning up historical outstanding accounts and establishing strong financial procedures.



For the right person, our intention is for this role to develop into a permanent full-time position around June 2027, taking ownership of the company’s day-to-day bookkeeping and finance function.



Initial Responsibilities



During the first 3–6 months, your priorities will include:



* Review and reconcile outstanding customer invoices

* Actively follow up overdue customer accounts

* Work through historical outstanding debts and payment discrepancies

* Maintain accurate Accounts Receivable records in Xero

* Generate customer invoices, deposits and balance invoices

* Allocate and reconcile customer payments

* Establish clear debtor-management and escalation procedures

* Prepare unresolved accounts for referral to external debt recovery where required

* Improve internal bookkeeping and finance processes

* Assist with Accounts Payable and supplier invoice management

* Maintain accurate supporting financial documentation

* Assist with bank and credit-card reconciliations

* Help establish efficient internal finance workflows and procedures

* Liaise with our existing Australian bookkeeping and accounting providers during the transition



Longer-Term Responsibilities



As the role develops, responsibilities will expand to include:



* Daily Xero bookkeeping

* Bank and credit-card reconciliations

* Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable

* Customer invoicing and payment tracking

* Weekly payroll processing

* STP and payroll administration

* Superannuation processing and monitoring

* Employee leave and payroll records

* Supplier payments and reconciliations

* Month-end reconciliations

* Monthly Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet and AR/AP reporting

* Management reporting

* Quarterly BAS preparation and supporting workpapers

* Maintaining BAS-ready accounts for review and lodgement by our Australian accountant

* Maintaining financial records and compliance calendars

* Monitoring cash flow and outstanding debt

* Ensuring overdue invoices are identified and actioned promptly

* Continuous improvement of internal financial systems and procedures



Our Australian company accountant will continue to manage BAS review and lodgement, annual financial statements, company tax returns and higher-level taxation and compliance matters.



What We’re Looking For



We are specifically looking for someone with previous experience working with Australian businesses or Australian accounting/bookkeeping firms.



You should have:



* Strong Xero experience

* Australian bookkeeping experience

* Strong Accounts Receivable and debt-management experience

* Experience with Australian payroll, STP and superannuation

* Understanding of Australian GST and BAS preparation

* Experience with bank, credit-card, AR and AP reconciliations

* Excellent attention to detail

* Excellent written and spoken English

* Confidence communicating professionally with Australian customers regarding outstanding accounts

* Strong organisational and follow-up skills

* Ability to investigate discrepancies rather than simply process transactions

* Ability to work independently and take ownership of the finance function



Experience with 
, Dext, e-commerce or the apparel industry would be advantageous but is not essential.



The Person We’re Looking For



This isn’t simply a data-entry bookkeeping position.



We want someone who takes ownership. If an invoice is overdue, you notice it and follow it up. If a payment doesn’t reconcile, you investigate it. If something doesn’t look right, you raise it. If an internal process isn’t working, you help improve it.



The successful candidate will gradually become a trusted member of the business responsible for ensuring our financial administration remains accurate, current and organised.



Hours & Salary

Location: Remote – Philippines

Working hours: Some overlap with Australian Eastern Time required

Indicative salary: ₱25,000–₱35,000 PHP per month, depending on experience



The initial 3–6 months will have a strong focus on finance clean-up, outstanding debt and establishing improved internal processes.



For a candidate who performs strongly, our intention is to progressively expand the position and transition it into a full-time 40-hour-per-week role around June 2027, with salary reviewed accordingly.



How to Apply

title: Senior Full-stack Engineer - Payments (POOLING - .NET and React)
description:
LOCATION: REMOTE

Working hours: Overlap required with US business hours (1 PM to 10 PM or 4PM to 1 AM Manila time, including breaks)



THE ROLE

You will build across the payments platform: the embeddable SDK that collects card and wallet credentials, the services that create sessions and route transactions to the right gateway, the tokenization boundaries that keep sensitive card data out of our systems, and the webhook and reconciliation flows that keep money accurate. This is not a role about building forms and CRUD screens. It is infrastructure that real money flows through, where a bug is not a broken layout but a failed transaction, a double charge, or a compliance i
. You will work both sides of the wire, and you need to be genuinely strong on both.



WHAT YOU'LL BE BUILDING

1. The payment SDK and client layer. Hosted-fields integration with iframe isolation, a gateway-agnostic API so integrators write one integration regardless of processor, and the client-side state model for declines, 3DS, retries, and timeouts.

2. The payment services. Session intent and gateway routing, tokenization boundaries, idempotency, HMAC-signed request flows, and the webhook and reconciliation logic that guarantees correctness.

3. The platform around it. Versioning and deprecation so we evolve without breaking live merchants, observability across the payment path, and the developer experience for the engineers who integrate against us.



TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS



- HARD REQUIREMENTS - 



1. 7+ years building production software across frontend and backend

2. Strong React and TypeScript. Not "I use React." You understand rendering behavior, state boundaries, effect lifecycles, and how to design a component API other engineers consume

3. Strong backend. .NET and React are our core stack. You can design services, reason about API contracts, debug across the stack, and hold your own in an architecture discussion

4. Payment systems experience. Gateway APIs, tokenization, hosted fields, webhooks, reconciliation, or equivalent work in a domain where correctness is non-negotiable

·5. Security fundamentals as instinct. Same-origin policy, CSP, CORS, XSS vectors, iframe isolation, token handling, why secrets never live in client bundles

·6. Agentic AI in your workflow. You use Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or equivalents as a daily driver, not a novelty. We build AI-native and expect you to move at that speed

7. Testing discipline. You write tests because untested payment code is a liability, not because a policy says to



- STRONG PREFERRENCE - 



1. Java, Kotlin, and Quarkus experience — strongly preferred

2. Hands-on experience with gateway and tokenization stacks

3. CI DSS scope reduction, SAQ A or SAQ A-EP work

4. 3D Secure 2 implementation

5. Cloud and DevOps exposure (Azure or AWS), CI/CD ownership



HOW WE WORK

We move fast and requirements change. You will not get a fully specified ticket handed to you. You will get a problem, the business context behind it, and the autonomy to solve it.

a. You ask the sharp question before writing code, not after shipping the wrong thing

b. You escalate ambiguity early instead of guessing quietly

c. You push back when an approach is wrong, with a better alternative

d. You are comfortable working directly with product and client stakeholders

e. You do not need to be managed into producing work you are proud of. If you have only worked in environments with detailed specs, dedicated QA, and long review cycles, you will find this uncomfortable. If you have worked in startups or fast-moving product teams, this will feel familiar.



We are explicit about this because it saves everyone time.

We are hiring for craft. That means naming things well, keeping abstractions honest, deleting code that should not exist, reading the gateway documentation rather than guessing, and caring what the integration feels like for the engineer on the other side. We would rather ship one correct payment flow than five that mostly work.

If that sounds like unnecessary perfectionism, we are not a fit. If it sounds like how software should have been built all along, we want to talk.



ABOUT OUTSIDEHIRE (
)



OutsideHire is a growing outsourcing company with over 75 employees, building custom products and solutions for our clients. We're dynamic, fast-paced, and always evolving!



WHY OUTSIDEHIRE?



- An inclusive and dynamic work environment that values creativity and collaboration

- Opportunities to work on cutting-edge projects that make an impact

- Perks: Competitive salary, remote work, professional development support, etc.

- A team that truly values your skills and contributions

While we are not interviewing for an immediate opening, successful applicants may be invited to participate in project-specific interviews when needs arise. Applications remain valid for 12 months *
