title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer - Workforce & Payroll Platform (POOLING - Agentic AI, Python, React)
description:
LOCATION: REMOTE

Working hours: Overlap required with US business hours (1 PM to 10 PM or 4PM to 1 AM Manila time, including breaks)



THE ROLE

The product tracks punches, pairs them into shifts, applies pay rules, and produces approved timecards. The next phase adds the money layer — pay rates, labor cost, payroll export — and the integrations that make the product sellable. You will own significant parts of that build end to end, across a Python backend and a React frontend, and you will do it with agentic AI tooling as a core part of how you work, not as a novelty.



This is a takeover, not a greenfield build. You will inherit code you did not write, branches that were never merged, and decisions that were never documented. Comfort with that is part of the job.



WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO

1. Build and harden the pay rate and labor-cost layer — the critical path to a sellable product. Rates, effective dating, overtime interaction, cost rollups.

2. Extend the punch pipeline (raw → paired → contextualized) and the calculation engine that turns shifts into payable hours.

3. Ship payroll export and the period-close/finalization flow that is currently locked.

4. Work across the GraphQL API (Django + Graphene) and the React client (Vite + Apollo) — you own features vertically, not by layer.

5. Land the integration surface: payroll providers, POS, and the billing/metering path that currently exists but is not wired to anything.

6. Drive merge discipline and release hygiene on a repository that has a significant backlog of unmerged work.

7. Use agentic AI tooling to move faster than a conventional senior engineer — and be able to explain and defend where you did and did not trust it.



TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS



- HARD REQUIREMENTS - 



1. AGENTIC AI ENGINEERING - Non-negotiable. You already build with agentic systems, not just chat. Concretely, we expect you to be able to speak to:

a. Running coding agents against a real codebase and getting production-quality output — planning, partitioning work, reviewing agent output critically.

b. Building agentic features into a product: tool/function calling, structured output, multi-step orchestration, retries and failure handling.

c. Context engineering — what goes in, what gets summarized, what gets retrieved.

d. Evaluation: how you know an agentic feature actually works, and what you do when it silently degrades.

e. Where agents are the wrong tool. Judgement here matters more than enthusiasm.

* We will ask you to walk us through something you shipped. “I use Copilot” is not an answer to this requirement.

2. PYTHON — strong. Django (5.x), ORM and migrations at a level where you are comfortable changing a schema that has live data behind it. Celery or comparable async task processing. GraphQL via Graphene is a plus; if you know GraphQL from another stack, that transfers.

3. REACT — strong. React 18+, TypeScript, Vite, Apollo Client or equivalent. You can own a feature’s UI without a designer holding your hand, and you know the difference between a screen that demos well and a screen that survives real use.

4. NODE.JS — working proficiency. Monorepo tooling (NX/pnpm), build pipelines, and the Node-side services in the stack. You do not need to be a Node specialist, but you must be able to work in it without friction.



- STRONGLY PREFERRED - 



1. Payroll systems - Pay rules, overtime law, effective-dated rates, pay periods, accruals, retroactive correction. This domain punishes people who learn it on the job — prior exposure is worth a great deal to us.

2. Payment systems - Stripe or comparable, subscription/seat-based billing, webhooks, idempotency, reconciliation. The platform meters seats; nothing currently bills against it.

3. Multi-tenant SaaS - tenant isolation, per-tenant configuration, and the ways both go wrong.

4. AWS (ECS, RDS, S3), Terraform or CDK, CI/CD you are willing to own.

5. Working in a codebase with incomplete documentation and reconstructing intent from the code itself.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR BEYOND THE STACK



1. You finish things. The single largest problem in the codebase you are inheriting is work that was built well and never landed. We care more about what you shipped than what you started.

2. You read before you write. This system has real logic in it that is not obvious. Rewriting it because it was easier than understanding it is the most expensive mistake available here.

3. You are honest about state. “Done” means merged, tested, and deployed. If something is 70% there, we want to hear 70%.

4. You handle money code with care. Hours become wages. Errors here are not bugs, they are payroll disputes.

5. You leave a trail. Decisions written down, migrations explained, runbooks that someone else can follow.



ABOUT OUTSIDEHIRE (
)



OutsideHire is a growing outsourcing company with over 75 employees, building custom products and solutions for our clients. We're dynamic, fast-paced, and always evolving!



WHY OUTSIDEHIRE?



- An inclusive and dynamic work environment that values creativity and collaboration

- Opportunities to work on cutting-edge projects that make an impact

- Perks: Competitive salary, remote work, professional development support, etc.

- A team that truly values your skills and contributions



* We are establishing a pre-vetted talent pool for anticipated contract opportunities launching in Q4 2026 - Q1 2027. While we are not interviewing for an immediate opening, successful applicants may be invited to participate in project-specific interviews when needs arise. Applications remain valid for 12 months *

title: Recruitment Delivery and Talent Manager
description:
Garry Howling Recruitment is a specialist recruitment business operating exclusively across the UK accountancy profession.



We have ambitious plans to build a high-growth, market-leading recruitment business, and we are looking for an exceptional Recruitment Delivery and Talent Manager to take ownership of candidate delivery and help build the high-performance talent function required to support that growth.



This is a hands-on recruitment-delivery position. You will personally identify, approach, engage and qualify high-quality candidates while taking responsibility for ensuring that priority vacancies receive consistent and effective candidate coverage.



The title “Manager” reflects the level of ownership, judgement and accountability required. It is not initially a people-management position. You will be expected to manage candidate pipelines, vacancy coverage, delivery standards, priorities, follow-up and your own performance at an exceptionally high level.



This is not an administrative resourcing role, and it is not suitable for someone who waits to receive a daily list of instructions. We need an intelligent, resilient and commercially aware individual who takes ownership, maintains momentum and makes things happen.



The purpose of the role



You will work closely with the founder of the business, who has more than 20 years’ experience recruiting exclusively within the UK accountancy-practice market.



Your responsibility will be to build and maintain a consistent pipeline of high-quality candidates, qualify them properly and progress them through the recruitment process.



You will undertake the detailed research, sourcing, engagement, qualification and follow-up required before involving the founder at the most commercially important stages.



The objective is not simply to generate names, searches, messages or activity. It is to create genuine candidate conversations, submissions, interviews, offers, successful appointments and long-term relationships.



You will remain responsible for each candidate, vacancy and agreed action until the required outcome has been achieved, accurately recorded and clearly communicated.



Key responsibilities



Candidate sourcing and market mapping



* Proactively identify high-quality accountancy professionals for current and future recruitment opportunities.

* Build detailed talent pools across specific locations, accountancy disciplines and levels of seniority.

* Research candidates thoroughly before making contact.

* Use LinkedIn, recruitment databases, online research, referrals, email, telephone and other appropriate channels.

* Develop effective search strategies rather than relying on obvious job titles or basic keyword searches.

* Map relevant candidates working within national, regional, independent and private-equity-backed accountancy firms.

* Identify candidate movement patterns between different types and sizes of firm.

* Maintain long-term pipelines in areas where suitable candidates are particularly difficult to find.

* Continually expand the business’s understanding of the available candidate market.



Candidate engagement



* Produce persuasive and highly personalised candidate approaches.

* Communicate confidently and professionally with UK accountancy professionals at different levels of seniority.

* Generate genuine interest rather than simply sending high volumes of generic messages.

* Follow up intelligently, consistently and persistently.

* Remain positive and productive when initial approaches receive no response or are rejected.

* Re-engage candidates who may previously have been unavailable or unwilling to consider a move.

* Build trusted relationships with candidates who may not be ready to move immediately.

* Ask candidates for appropriate introductions and referrals.

* Ensure that every worthwhile candidate relationship has a clear and dated next action.



Candidate qualification



* Conduct detailed initial conversations with prospective candidates.

* Establish their current role, responsibilities, technical experience and level of seniority.

* Understand their qualifications, study status and professional development.

* Explore the size and complexity of any client portfolio they manage.

* Establish their client-facing, review, supervisory and team-management responsibilities.

* Understand why they may consider moving and determine the strength of that motivation.

* Record their current salary, expectations, notice period and availability.

* Establish their preferred locations, realistic commuting area and working-arrangement expectations.

* Understand the type, size, culture and ownership structure of firm that would suit them.

* Identify other interviews, applications or recruitment processes already underway.

* Assess counteroffer, withdrawal and non-commencement risks.

* Obtain a current CV and all relevant information before arranging a conversation with the founder.

* Avoid progressing applicants who are unsuitable, weakly motivated or insufficiently qualified.



Vacancy delivery and prioritisation



* Develop a thorough understanding of every priority vacancy.

* Review and prioritise vacancies according to urgency, commercial value and likelihood of success.

* Create a clear candidate-sourcing and engagement plan for each priority assignment.

* Build sufficiently broad pipelines rather than relying on one or two possible candidates.

* Monitor candidate coverage and identify gaps before momentum is lost.

* Maintain a clear, dated next action against every active candidate and vacancy.

* Recognise when a search, message or target market is not producing the required results.

* Diagnose whether problems arise from targeting, candidate availability, outreach, qualification or the vacancy itself.

* Recommend practical corrective action rather than simply reporting that a search is difficult.

* Escalate genuine obstacles promptly, supported by evidence and a recommended solution.

* Ensure that no viable candidate or commercially important vacancy becomes inactive through inadequate follow-up.



Candidate presentation and recruitment-process management



* Match candidates intelligently to suitable vacancies, firms and working environments.

* Prepare accurate and persuasive candidate summaries.

* Ensure that candidates understand opportunities before their details are presented.

* Arrange candidate meetings and interviews efficiently.

* Provide complete and accurate information to everyone involved.

* Prepare candidates thoroughly for interviews.

* Obtain detailed feedback promptly after interviews.

* Progress next steps without avoidable delay.

* Maintain candidate engagement through multiple interview stages.

* Support candidates through offer, resignation and notice-period stages.

* Identify and manage the risk of counteroffers, withdrawals and failed commencements.

* Maintain appropriate alternative candidates until an appointment is secure.

* Continue communicating with placed candidates until they have commenced successfully.



Delivery performance and continuous improvement



* Monitor personal sourcing, engagement and conversion performance.

* Understand where candidates are being lost within the recruitment process.

* Review the effectiveness of searches, messages, follow-up and qualification.

* Test and improve sourcing strategies and candidate approaches.

* Identify patterns in successful and unsuccessful activity.

* Maintain accurate pipeline information and delivery forecasts.

* Provide concise progress updates supported by evidence.

* Critique your own performance honestly and identify specific improvements.

* Help develop consistent delivery standards and processes as the business grows.

* Share observations, ideas and recommended actions rather than waiting to be asked.

* Maintain both pace and quality without allowing either to become an excuse for weakness in the other.



CRM and information management



* Maintain complete and accurate candidate records within the CRM.

* Record all material conversations, messages, motivations, preferences and agreed actions.

* Ensure that notes are sufficiently detailed for another person to understand precisely what has happened and what should happen next.

* Maintain accurate vacancy, interview, offer and placement activity.

* Protect confidential candidate and client information.

* Follow all business procedures relating to data protection, systems and AI use.

* Ensure that every completed action is properly recorded and communicated.



The reality of successful recruitment delivery



Successful recruitment delivery requires intelligence, judgement and strong communication. It also requires the discipline to repeat essential activities consistently.



Researching, searching, approaching, following up, updating records and reviewing pipelines must be completed every working day. Some candidates will not respond. Others will decline opportunities, withdraw or change their minds.



The successful person must be able to maintain pace, accuracy, attention to detail and a positive attitude even when work becomes repetitive or results are not immediate.



Starting a task is not the same as completing it. Sending one message is not effective follow-up. Identifying one candidate is not adequate vacancy coverage. Reporting a difficulty is not the same as recommending and implementing a solution.



We need someone who remains personally responsible for moving work towards the required outcome.



The person we are looking for



The successful applicant will be:



* **Exceptionally proactive:** You act without waiting to be repeatedly instructed.

* **Tenacious:** You remain focused through rejection, non-response and setbacks.

* **Consistent:** You maintain strong standards every day, including when work is repetitive.

* **Accountable:** You accept personal responsibility for your commitments and results.

* **Completion-focused:** You follow work through to its proper conclusion.

* **Commercially aware:** You understand how candidate activity contributes to interviews, placements and revenue.

* **Resourceful:** You can take limited information, research it and determine the best next action.

* **Independent:** You can organise and progress your work without constant supervision.

* **Analytical:** You can identify patterns, diagnose problems and improve your approach.

* **Self-critical:** You review your own work honestly and continually seek improvement.

* **Quality-conscious:** You pursue the highest practical standard while maintaining appropriate pace.

* **Positive and resilient:** You remain constructive and productive when results take time.

* **Highly organised:** You can manage numerous candidates, vacancies, deadlines and follow-ups without losing control.

* **An exceptional communicator:** Your spoken and written English is of an outstanding professional standard.

* **Dependable:** If you commit to an action, it will be completed properly and on time.

* **Adaptable:** You respond constructively to changing priorities within a growing entrepreneurial business.



Essential requirements



* Educated to degree level or able to demonstrate equivalent intellectual and professional capability.

* Excellent written and spoken English.

* Substantial experience in recruitment delivery, candidate sourcing, executive search or talent acquisition.

* Evidence of personally building and maintaining candidate pipelines.

* Experience conducting candidate screening or qualification conversations.

* Evidence of progressing candidates through recruitment processes.

* Strong online research and talent-mapping capability.

* Confidence communicating with experienced UK professionals.

* Ability to create persuasive, personalised candidate outreach.

* Experience using a CRM, applicant-tracking system or comparable database.

* Excellent attention to detail and record-keeping.

* Demonstrable experience of working independently.

* Evidence of taking ownership and completing work without being chased.

* Ability to sustain consistent activity and standards over time.

* Reliable computer equipment, high-speed internet and a professional home-working environment.

* Availability to work approximately 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. UK time, Monday to Friday.



Experience recruiting within accountancy, financial services or another professional-services market would be advantageous but is not essential.



Performance measures



Success will be assessed through measurable delivery outcomes, including:



* Relevant candidates identified and engaged.

* Meaningful candidate conversations completed.

* Fully qualified candidate meetings booked and attended.

* Current CVs and complete candidate information obtained.

* Suitable candidate submissions made.

* Submission-to-interview conversion.

* Interview-to-offer conversion.

* Offer acceptance and successful commencement rates.

* Candidate pipelines developed and maintained.

* Priority-vacancy coverage.

* Candidate relationships reactivated.

* Candidate referrals generated.

* Speed, quality and consistency of follow-up.

* Accuracy and completeness of CRM records.

* Reliability of pipeline information and forecasts.

* Completion of agreed actions without reminders.

* Evidence of independent judgement and continuous improvement.



Activity matters, but activity without quality, progression or outcomes will not be regarded as success.



Supporting the founder and wider business



You will become a highly dependable extension of the founder and protect his time by ensuring that research, initial engagement and qualification have been completed properly before involving him.



You will:



* Provide concise and commercially useful candidate information.

* Prepare the founder thoroughly for candidate conversations.

* Arrange worthwhile candidate meetings directly into his diary.

* Complete agreed follow-up actions promptly.

* Anticipate what should happen next.

* Raise problems early and provide a recommended solution.

* Create certainty through accurate information, attention to detail and dependable execution.



As the delivery function grows, there may be scope to help establish processes, share best practice and support the development of additional delivery resources. The immediate priority, however, is outstanding personal delivery rather than people management.



 What this role is not



This is not a general virtual-assistant, data-entry or administrative position.



It is not suitable for someone who:



* Needs every task broken down into detailed instructions.

* Waits to be told what to do next.

* Loses motivation when work becomes repetitive.

* Sends one message and considers the task complete.

title: Static ad designer for Meta ads
description:
We run e-commerce brands and advertise on
 and Instagram. Static ads are a big part of what works for us. We're looking for a designer who can take over producing them.



What you'll do



You'll create static ads based on briefs and copy we provide. Usually that means taking an ad that already performs and making variations of it: different product, background, headline or format. Think 5 to 10 statics per batch, delivered within a few days.



You'll also clean up product photos when needed: cutouts, shadows, retouching, and making sure the product looks sharp and correct.



What we expect



1. You've designed static ads for e-commerce or DTC brands before, and you can show examples in your portfolio. Logos and websites don't count.

2. You're strong in photo editing, especially compositing and retouching (Photoshop or similar). The product has to look real, because it's the hero of every ad.

3. You know common ad formats, like Pubity-style posts, chat screenshots and comment threads, and you understand why simple and readable usually wins.

4. You can create ads in languages you don't speak. We advertise in each market's native language, so you need to understand what an ad says and why it works before you design it. That means using AI properly: translating the copy, understanding the DTC messaging behind it, and checking your final text word for word. Mistakes in the copy aren't acceptable.

5. You're comfortable working with AI tools. We'll give you access to a Higgsfield account and a ChatGPT or Claude account for generating images, working out concepts and handling translations.



How it works



Freelance and remote, ongoing work if we're a good fit. We start with a small paid test: we'll send you one of our winning ads plus product photos, and you make 3 variations within 48 hours.



To apply



Send 3 to 5 winning static ads you've made for e-commerce brands and explain why they're winning, and send us 3 losing ads you've made, and explain to us why they were considered losing ads.



Salary

Base pay + 5% commission on the ad spend of a winning batch (KPI must be 2+ roas and only counts from a minimum of €500 spend in past 30 days.

- Listing to close: Take over the client at verbal acceptance of the listing and coordinate everything through closing: paperwork, deadlines, vendors, title, lender, and status updates.

- Contract to close: Open each file at contract acceptance, deliver documents to title and lender, build and run the deadline calendar (inspection, financing, appraisal, closing), chase signatures and missing documents, send weekly status updates, prepare closing paperwork and commission disbursement, and archive the completed file.

- Broker compliance checks: Audit every file against our Missouri compliance checklist. No file is marked complete and no commission is released until the checklist passes.

IMPORTANT: This is an unlicensed administrative role. You will never negotiate contract terms, give advice on price or terms, solicit new business by phone, or conduct showings.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

- Zero missed contract deadlines

- 100% of closed files pass the compliance checklist before commission release

- Listings live in the MLS within 24 hours with zero data errors

- Broker and agent requests answered the same business day



REQUIREMENTS

- 2+ years supporting US real estate transactions (transaction coordinator, listing coordinator, or brokerage admin)

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Experience with a CRM (Follow Up Boss or similar), MLS entry, e-signature platforms, and Google Workspace. Rentvine or property management software is a plus.

- Available Monday to Friday on US Central Time

- Reliable high-speed internet with backup power and internet

- Very detail-oriented. You catch the wrong date on page 7.

- Comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.) in your daily work



COMPENSATION

- Base pay: $800 USD per month, paid twice a month (Wise or similar). Independent contractor.

- Closing bonus: $30 for every brokerage closing you coordinate in the month

- Pace bonus: an extra $100 in any month with 8 or more closings

- Operations bonus: $150 per quarter for hitting property management and operations targets

- 13th month pay: one month of base pay every December (pro-rated in year one)

- Pay review at 90 days, then every year



Example months:

5 closings = $950 total

8 closings = $1,140 total

12 closings = $1,260 total

Quarterly bonus and 13th month pay are on top of this.



HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY)

We only accept applications through WhatsApp. Do not call this number. WhatsApp messages only. Applications sent any other way will not be reviewed.



WhatsApp: 
Send us these 4 things on WhatsApp:



1) A TEXT MESSAGE that starts with the words "SMPL Coordinator" followed by your full name and your OnlineJobs.ph profile link.



2) A VIDEO OF YOURSELF (1 to 2 minutes). We want to see and hear you.

   - Your face must be clearly visible the whole time. Good lighting, no filters, no background music.

   - Record it yourself in one take. No AI voices, avatars, or edited clips.

   - Start by saying your full name and today's date.

   - Then read this script out loud:



"Hi, this is [your name], your transaction coordinator with SMPL Realty. I'm calling with an update on your home at 123 Main Street. The buyer's home inspection was completed yesterday, and we expect their repair request by Friday at 5 p.m. Central Time. Once we receive it, your agent will review it with you and go over your options. In the meantime, the appraisal has been ordered, and title work is in progress. Our closing date is still on track for October 30th. If you have any questions, please call or text me at this number. Thank you, and have a great day."

3) YOUR RESUME (PDF or Word).

title: Meta Ads Specialist - Ecommerce/Swimwear/Bridal
description:
Remote | Contract / Part-Time with opportunity to grow



We are looking for an experienced **Meta Ads Specialist** to manage and scale paid advertising across our own ecommerce brands and selected ecommerce clients.



Required

- 5+ years experience working with Meta Ads

- 5+ years experience working with lingerie/swimwear for women and men successfully. 



*NOTE: This is not an entry-level media buying role. Do not apply if you are new to Meta Ads +Ecommerce.

* Proof of work will be required, and a reference check will be done. 



A major part of this position will involve managing a swimwear brand specialising in micro bikinis and bold swimwear. It is a challenging Meta account that requires someone who understands both **ecommerce performance marketing and Meta's advertising policies around swimwear, lingerie, body exposure and suggestive creative**.



For this reason, **previous hands-on experience running Meta Ads for a bikini, swimwear, lingerie or closely related fashion brand is required.**



## What You Will Be Responsible For



You will take ownership of Meta advertising across multiple accounts, including:



* Developing Meta Ads strategies based on revenue, ROAS, CPA and profitability targets

* Managing
 and Instagram campaigns through Meta Ads Manager

* Structuring and optimising campaigns across prospecting, retargeting and existing customer audiences

* Managing Advantage+ Shopping, manual campaigns and testing structures where appropriate

* Developing systematic creative testing strategies

* Identifying winning creatives, hooks, offers, audiences and landing pages

* Scaling profitable campaigns while controlling CPA and maintaining efficiency

* Analysing performance across campaign, ad set and individual creative level

* Monitoring attribution and comparing Meta performance against Shopify, GA4 and other available data

* Working with our creative and ecommerce teams to develop new advertising concepts

* Providing clear briefs for static ads, video ads, UGC and other creative assets

* Identifying account issues before they become expensive problems

* Keeping up with changes to Meta's advertising platform, algorithms and policies

* Ensuring ad accounts do not get flagged for violations or get banned

* Producing concise performance reports with clear recommendations and next actions



## Swimwear Brand – A Key Part of This Role, requires a more experienced media buyer than a conventional ecommerce account.



The brand operates within a category where Meta can interpret certain bikini imagery as overly sexualised or restricted, even when the products themselves are legitimate swimwear.



You will need to understand how to:



* Advertise swimwear and revealing fashion while remaining within Meta advertising policies

* Identify which creatives are likely to trigger disapprovals or account restrictions

* Develop advertising concepts that maintain the identity of a bold brand without unnecessarily increasing policy risk

* Separate organic brand creative from paid-media-safe creative where required

* Work around limited creative options without producing bland advertising

* Troubleshoot rejected ads and account restrictions

* Scale a fashion brand where visual creative is one of the primary drivers of performance

* Develop creative angles that appeal to different customer segments while protecting the account



We are **not** looking for someone to simply upload whatever creative is supplied and wait to see whether Meta approves it. We need someone who understands the platform well enough to anticipate problems and develop solutions.



## You Must Have



* Proven experience managing Meta Ads for ecommerce businesses

* **Previous experience advertising a bikini, swimwear, lingerie or closely related brand**

* Strong working knowledge of Meta Ads Manager

* Strong understanding of Meta advertising policies relating to fashion, swimwear, lingerie and suggestive content

* Experience managing ecommerce conversion campaigns

* Experience with Shopify-based businesses

* Strong understanding of ROAS, MER, CPA, CPM, CTR, CVR, AOV and customer acquisition economics

* Experience testing and scaling creatives systematically

* Ability to interpret performance data rather than relying solely on Meta's recommendations

* Experience managing multiple advertising accounts

* Strong written communication and reporting skills

* Ability to work independently and take ownership of performance



## Highly Regarded



Experience with any of the following would be valuable:



* Women's fashion or apparel

* Intimate apparel

* Bridal Brand 

* Gifting 

* Beauty or lifestyle ecommerce

* UGC advertising

* Creative strategy

* Klaviyo

* GA4

* Shopify analytics

* Landing-page optimisation

* Conversion-rate optimisation

* International ecommerce campaigns

* Australian and US ecommerce markets



## What We Are Not Looking For



This role will not suit someone whose experience consists primarily of:



* Boosting social media posts

* Lead generation for local service businesses

* Organic social media management

* Following automated Meta recommendations without independent analysis

* Running one campaign structure across every account

* Reporting vanity metrics without understanding commercial performance



We need a **performance-focused ecommerce media buyer** who understands that creative, merchandising, offers, website conversion and paid media all influence results.



## What Success Looks Like



You will be expected to understand each business commercially, not simply operate Ads Manager.



That means being able to look at an account and explain:



**What is working?

What is not working?

Why?

What should we test next?

What should we stop spending money on?

Where is the opportunity to scale?**



You should be comfortable challenging assumptions and recommending changes when the data supports them.



## About The Businesses



We are a brisbane based marketing & Development agency with a number of Australian Ecommerce Clients. You will work across a mix of internally owned brands and ecommerce clients covering areas such as fashion, bridal, gifting, retail and specialist ecommerce.



You will work closely with a team covering ecommerce strategy, Shopify development, Google Ads, SEO,
 marketing, design and conversion optimisation.



This gives you access to the wider ecommerce operation rather than being expected to solve every performance problem through advertising alone.



## How To Apply



Please include:



1. A short introduction outlining your Meta Ads experience.

2. The **swimwear, bikini, lingerie or intimate-apparel brands you have previously managed**.

3. Approximate monthly Meta ad spend you have personally managed.

4. Examples of ecommerce accounts you have successfully grown.

5. The markets you have advertised in.

6. Your experience dealing with Meta ad disapprovals, restricted creative or account restrictions.

7. Your approach to creative testing.

8. The metrics you use to determine whether an ecommerce account is performing well.

9. Your availability and preferred working arrangement.



Please include screenshots, case studies or performance data demonstrating results.



**Applications without relevant ecommerce Meta Ads experience will not be considered. 



Previous experience within swimwear, bikinis, lingerie or a closely related category is essential.**

title: Apparel Illustrator / Graphic Designer – Japanese-Inspired Clothing Brand
description:
We are looking for a talented Illustrator / Graphic Designer to create original artwork for an established e-commerce clothing brand.



This is NOT a position for creating ads, social media graphics, website banners, or marketing materials.



Your job will be focused on one thing: creating original artwork and designs that will be printed on clothing.



What We're Looking For



We want someone who is genuinely talented at illustration and design.



Our brand is heavily inspired by Japanese culture and aesthetics, but our designs can vary significantly in style. You should be comfortable adapting to different visual directions rather than being limited to one specific illustration style.



We care much more about the quality of your work and portfolio than how many years of experience you have.



Experience creating artwork for apparel, streetwear, or clothing brands is preferred, but not required.



Your Responsibilities



Your main responsibility will be creating original artwork for our clothing designs.



We will provide concepts, references, ideas, and creative direction for many designs. For some projects, you may also be given more freedom to interpret an idea in your own way.



You should be able to:



* Create original illustrations from scratch

* Work from references and creative direction

* Adapt to different illustration and graphic styles

* Combine illustration, composition, and typography when a design requires it

* Make revisions based on feedback

* Deliver at least 4–5+ quality designs per week

* Prepare artwork suitable for printing on apparel



Knowledge of designing for DTG printing and preparing print-ready artwork is a plus.



What We Care About



We're not looking for someone who can simply use graphic design software.



We're looking for someone who has a strong artistic eye and actual illustration/design ability.



You should understand composition, typography, color, balance, and what makes artwork visually appealing on a T-shirt or other piece of clothing.



Most importantly, you should be able to create original artwork, not simply combine templates or stock graphics. At the very beginning of your application, write the word SAKURA so we know you read the entire job post.



AI tools may be used as part of your creative process when appropriate, but you must have the ability to create and modify artwork yourself. We are not looking for someone who simply generates AI images and submits them as finished designs.



Work Arrangement



We are open to both full-time and part-time applicants.



You can work on your own schedule. We care primarily about communication, reliability, meeting deadlines, and the quality of the designs you deliver. 



There is also opportunity for performance-based bonuses and pay increases for consistently strong work.



Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a paid design test before being hired.



How to Apply



Please answer ALL of the following questions in your application:



1. Tell us about your experience as an illustrator or graphic designer.



2. Have you created designs for clothing, apparel, or streetwear brands before? If yes, please explain what you worked on.



3. What software do you use to create your illustrations and designs?



4. Which illustration/design styles are you strongest at?



5. Are you comfortable creating Japanese-inspired artwork in different styles?



6. Are you able to create original illustrations from scratch?



7. Do you have experience preparing artwork for DTG printing or other apparel printing methods?



8. Do you use AI tools as part of your design process? If yes, explain exactly how you use them.



9. How many high-quality apparel designs do you believe you can realistically complete per week?



10. Are you currently working for another company or client? If yes, approximately how many hours per week?



11. Are you looking for full-time or part-time work?



12. Please provide a link to your portfolio.



Your portfolio is the most important part of your application.



Please send examples that demonstrate your actual illustration and artwork abilities. We are especially interested in apparel graphics, illustrations, streetwear designs, Japanese-inspired artwork, or similar work.



If your portfolio mostly consists of advertisements, social media posts, website banners, Canva designs, or other marketing graphics, this position is probably not the right fit.



Applications without a portfolio or without answers to the questions above will not be considered.



We're looking for someone we can work with long-term who can consistently create strong, original artwork for our brand.

title: Life Insurance Administrative Virtual Assistant
description:
** PLEASE READ LIFE INSURANCE EXPERIENCE REQUIRED **



**Company:** Beacon Global Operations

**Position:** Life Insurance Administrative Virtual Assistant

**Work Type:** Remote



## About Beacon



Beacon Global Operations provides specialized back-office administrative support to life insurance brokers and agencies across the United States.



Our Administrative VAs help brokers manage the work that happens **after a life insurance application is submitted**, including pending requirements, carrier follow-up, policy delivery, client documentation, and book-of-business administration.



## REQUIRED: LIFE INSURANCE EXPERIENCE



**Previous life insurance experience is required for this position.**



We are specifically looking for candidates who have worked with **U.S.-based life insurance agents, brokers, agencies, IMOs/FMOs, or life insurance carriers** and understand the life insurance application and underwriting process.



You should already be familiar with concepts such as:



* Pending requirements

* Carrier portals

* Application status

* Underwriting requirements

* Policy issue and placement

* Policy packets

* Beneficiary and ownership information

* Bank drafts and payment information

* Client documentation

* Policy conservation and lapse prevention



**Experience in other industries does not substitute for life insurance experience.**



General VA, real estate, healthcare, customer service, appointment setting, or administrative experience alone will **not** qualify you for this position.



## Responsibilities



Your primary responsibility will be helping life insurance brokers manage their post-sale administrative workload.



Typical tasks include:



* Checking carrier portals for application and policy updates

* Reviewing and completing **pending requirements**

* Following up with clients for missing documents, signatures, banking information, identification, or other requirements

* Following up with carriers regarding outstanding cases

* Tracking applications from submission through issue and placement

* Sending and following up on **policy packets**

* Confirming clients have received required policy documents

* Assisting with policy delivery requirements

* Monitoring policies that may be at risk of lapsing or cancelling

* Assisting with policy conservation and administrative follow-up

* Updating case notes and client records

* Maintaining accurate task and policy statuses

* Suppressing leads after applications or sales when required

* Updating CRM records and client information

* Organizing documents and maintaining accurate case files

* Communicating clearly with brokers regarding outstanding requirements and case updates

* Completing other life-insurance-related back-office administrative tasks



## What We Expect



We are looking for someone who understands that outstanding requirements can directly impact whether a life insurance policy gets issued and placed.



You must be:



* Highly organized

* Detail-oriented

* Comfortable managing multiple insurance cases at once

* Proactive about following up on outstanding requirements

* Able to identify cases that require urgent attention

* Comfortable navigating multiple carrier websites and portals

* Able to communicate professionally with clients, brokers, and carriers

* Consistent with documenting your work

* Comfortable following established SOPs and workflows

* Responsible when handling confidential client information



You should not need to be taught the basics of how a life insurance application moves through underwriting.



## Qualifications



**Required:**



* Previous professional experience in the **U.S. life insurance industry**

* Experience working with life insurance applications and pending requirements

* Experience using life insurance carrier portals

* Understanding of the application → underwriting → issue → placement process

* Strong written and spoken English

* Strong attention to detail

* Reliable computer and internet connection

* Ability to follow standardized procedures and maintain accurate records



Experience with tools such as **GoHighLevel (GHL), CRMs, electronic signature platforms, password managers, and task-management systems** is helpful, but life insurance experience is the primary requirement.



## Important



This is **not a cold-calling or insurance sales position**.



Beacon Administrative VAs focus primarily on **post-sale operations and administrative support** so that licensed brokers can focus on selling and advising their clients.



### To Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. How many years of life insurance experience you have.

2. What company, agency, IMO/FMO, or insurance organization you worked with.

3. Your specific responsibilities in that role.

4. Which life insurance carriers you have experience working with.

5. Your experience handling **pending requirements**.

6. Which carrier portals, CRMs, and insurance systems you have used.



**Applications without previous life insurance experience will not be considered.**

ABOUT US



Kunstsokken is a Dutch brand. We license artworks from museums and turn them into socks. Van Gogh, Monet, Hokusai, Klimt, Delft Blue, plus direct collaborations with museums. We are based in the Netherlands. The founders are Tako and Jesse.



We sell online, and paid social is our main growth channel. Our statics have to look like they belong next to the art on the sock, not like a discount flyer.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Design static ads for
 and Instagram: feed 4:5, story 9:16, square 1:1.

- Build offer cards that state the offer in one glance.

- Design carousels where card one carries the hook and the rest keep people swiping.

- Take one winning concept and adapt it into many sizes and many variants without the composition falling apart.

- Design the occasional organic social post for Instagram and
.



Volume: 15 to 20 finished statics a week, counting format adaptations and variants. Usually 4 to 6 concepts, each shipped across sizes.



HOW THE WEEK WORKS



Monday: you get a batch of concept blueprints. Each one has the avatar, the hook, the format, the offer, the landing page and reference ads.

During the week: you ask questions in writing and post first drafts.

Friday: you deliver the finished batch.

Monday: you get a written scorecard on last week's batch, with the actual ad performance data, plus the new blueprints.



The founder writes the briefs and reviews the work. This is an async role. You have to read a brief properly and ask the right question early instead of guessing.



That Monday scorecard is worth saying twice: you will find out which of your designs made money and which did not. Most design jobs never tell you.



WHAT YOU GET TO WORK WITH



- A photographer's shot library, with real product and lifestyle photography.

- A separate library of AI generated shots.

- An AI content producer on the team who generates new AI assets on request.

- A photo retoucher who handles product thumbnails, so that is not on your plate.

- A brand kit: Poppins and Libre Baskerville, our colours and logo files.

- We also have HTML ad templates that render statics at exact pixel sizes. They are there if you want them and ignorable if you do not. Work in Figma, Photoshop or whatever you work best in. We care about the output, not the tool.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Required:

- 2 or more years designing static ads for paid social or ecommerce. Not logo packages. Not brochures.

- Photoshop and Figma at a professional level.

- You can show us real ads you designed that actually ran on Meta.

- Clean cutouts. No white halo, no chewed edges, real shadows.

- Strong typography. You understand hierarchy, and you know when to stop.

- You can take one concept and ship it in 4:5, 9:16 and 1:1 without it breaking.

- Good written English. You work from written briefs.

- You can start on 6 October 2026 and commit long term.



Nice to have:

- Light motion work, for example a static that also gets a subtle animated version.

- Experience designing the same layout in more than one language. Our ads run in Dutch, English, German and French, and German words are long.



PAY AND TERMS



- up to $1,500 per month (with possible room to grow). Where you land depends on your experience and your trial.

- $150 bonus, one time, for every ad you designed that reaches $5,000 in spend within 90 days of launch. No cap on how many ads can earn it.

- Paid monthly through Wise.

- Freelance contractor. You handle your own taxes.

- Paid trial task before we hire, $60, roughly 3 to 4 hours. We pay for it whether or not we hire you.

- You work on your own machine with your own software. If we ever require a specific paid tool, we pay for it.

- The work you deliver for us belongs to Kunstsokken.

- 30 day review after you start. After that, two weeks notice from either side.



HOW TO APPLY



Read this part carefully. Applications that skip a step are not reviewed.



1. Start your application with the word Zonnebloemen. First word, nothing before it.

2. Send a link to 5 to 8 static ads you designed yourself. Real ads that ran, not mockups on a dribbble background.

3. For 3 of them, write one line: what was the offer, and who was it aimed at.

4. Show us one concept you adapted into at least three formats, so we can see how you handle 4:5, 9:16 and 1:1.

5. Tell us which tools you use and how long you have used them.

6. Send a screenshot of a speed test and one line describing your computer.

7. Tell us your time zone and which hours you can overlap with 09:00 to 17:00 Central European Time. We need at least 4 hours of overlap.

8. Tell us your expected monthly rate and confirm you can start on 6 October 2026.

9. Look at our live ads in the Meta Ad Library, linked in the post. Pick one you would change, and tell us in a few sentences what you would do differently and why.

10. Send one ad you did NOT design that you think is excellent, and say in two sentences why it works.



We reply to every application that follows these steps. Shortlisted candidates get the paid trial task, then a 30 minute video call.

title: E-Commerce Bookkeeper & Inventory Accountant (QuickBooks Online) – Remote, Long-Term
description:
We are a fast-growing CPG (consumer packaged goods) company in the USA, selling through TikTok Shop, Amazon, Shopify and retail stores. We are looking for a detail-oriented QuickBooks Online bookkeeper to keep our books accurate and current, and to grow with us long-term.

This is not a general virtual assistant position. You will own our entire bookkeeping function, from daily transactions to the monthly close, including inventory valuation and Cost of Goods Sold (COGS), for a multi-channel e-commerce business. You will be our single point of contact for the books, and you will work with our outside tax preparer as needed.

What You Will Do

Sales and Payout Reconciliation - Record and reconcile sales from TikTok Shop, Amazon, and Shopify in QuickBooks Online - Match marketplace and processor payouts to bank deposits, including fees, refunds, returns, chargebacks, reserves, and payout timing - Track sales tax, marketplace facilitator activity, and channel-level revenue

Core Bookkeeping - Categorize transactions and keep the chart of accounts clean - Complete monthly bank and credit card reconciliations - Manage Accounts Payable: enter vendor bills, track due dates, and match bills to purchase orders - Manage Accounts Receivable (wholesale or other invoiced sales, if applicable) - Reconcile balance sheet accounts each month

Inventory and COGS (Monthly) - Gather inventory data from TikTok Shop, Amazon (including FBA inventory), Shopify, and our supplier and purchase records - Reconcile inventory quantities and costs, and complete the monthly inventory valuation - Calculate inventory and COGS adjustments and record the journal entries in QuickBooks Online - Investigate unusual items: negative quantities, cost variances, missing or duplicate SKUs, and differences between our records and channel reports - Keep a clear monthly inventory workpaper

Month-End Close and Reporting - Complete a monthly close on a consistent schedule - Prepare the Profit & Loss and Balance Sheet, and review both for accuracy - Report on profitability by channel (TikTok Shop, Amazon, Shopify) and flag unusual trends - Prepare year-end records and coordinate with our tax preparer

Process and Communication - Investigate discrepancies instead of ignoring them, and document what you find - Keep organized records and follow (or help write) simple SOPs - Flag problems early and ask questions when something doesn’t make sense

Must-Have Requirements

3+ years of bookkeeping experience with U.S. companies

Strong QuickBooks Online skills (reconciliations, journal entries, month-end close)

Experience reconciling e-commerce or marketplace payouts (Amazon, Shopify, TikTok Shop, or similar)

Solid understanding of accrual accounting and financial statements

Direct experience with inventory valuation and COGS (e-commerce, retail, or product businesses)

Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills

Clear written English

Reliable, honest, and comfortable working independently

Bonus: CPG Experience

We will pay more, and give priority, to applicants who have worked with a consumer packaged goods (CPG) company. For example, food, beverage, beauty, or household products. This helps most with: - Inventory and COGS concepts (product costs, landed costs, and co-packer or manufacturer invoices) - Trade spend, promotions, and marketplace fees - Working with a company that manufactures or sources its own products

Also Helpful

Amazon Seller Central (FBA) reports

TikTok Shop Seller Center reports

A2X, Link My Books, or similar e-commerce accounting tools

Sales tax filing experience

Experience with U.S. CPA or accounting firms

Important

We are not looking for someone who simply enters whatever number they are given. If a payout doesn’t match the sales report, we expect you to find out why and tell us.

Schedule and Commitment

Long-term, recurring work, with a consistent weekly schedule

Some overlap with Pacific Time business hours for questions and review

More hours and responsibility are available as we grow

Compensation

Pay is based on your experience and expertise. CPG experience earns a higher rate. Raises are available as you prove your accuracy and reliability.

How to Apply

Please read carefully. Start your application with the words: CPG BOOKKEEPER. Applications that skip this or the video will not be considered.

Then answer the following:

Describe your QuickBooks Online experience and how many years you have used it.

Describe your experience with e-commerce or marketplace sales (Amazon, Shopify, TikTok Shop). Which reports and tools did you use?

Walk us through how you reconcile a marketplace payout to a bank deposit, including fees, refunds, and reserves.

Have you worked for a CPG company (food, beverage, beauty, household, or similar)? Describe what you did. This is a bonus, not a requirement.

Describe your inventory valuation and COGS experience. What costing method(s) have you used, and about how many SKUs?

Walk us through how you would complete a monthly inventory valuation and the COGS journal entry.

Our Shopify report shows $10,000 in sales, but the bank deposit is $9,150. What would you do? Explain your process.

Our records show 940 units on hand, but Amazon’s report shows 1,000. What would you do?

Tell us about a time you found an accounting or inventory error that someone else missed.

Rate your Excel/Google Sheets skills from 1 to 10 and give an example of something advanced you have built.

What hours are you available in Philippine Time?

What is your expected rate in USD (hourly) 

Video introduction (required): Include a link to a 60-90 second unscripted video or voice recording. Tell us your name, your relevant experience, and why you would be good at this role. Please do not read a script.

What Happens Next

Strong applicants will be invited to an interview. We care more about accuracy, problem-solving, and reliability than an impressive résumé.

title: Senior Video Editor & Colorist
description:
Hi there! 👋 We're Unrendered Studio, a humble creative studio out of New York. We make strategy, campaigns, and content for health, wellness, and tech brands.



We're lean on purpose. The team is spread across the globe, and we're growing, which is why you're here 😊



One quick note before you scroll: we know job posts usually read like a list of demands. This isn't that. We'd much rather hear from someone excited and honest about where they are than someone who ticks every box on paper.



ABOUT THE ROLE



This is the other end of our pipeline from the short-form role. You'd take camera-original footage and build the whole thing: structure, pacing, grade, finish. The work is brand films, campaign pieces, and product content, shot log across a couple of bodies with phone footage mixed in, and it all needs to look like one hand made it.



Right now all of the grading lands on our founder, which isn't where it should sit, so color is the urgent half of this job. The editing is the ongoing half: story-driven cuts, and the graded masters our short-form editors work from.



We know that combination is rare. Plenty of senior editors don't really grade, and plenty of colorists don't cut. If you're strong in one and genuinely solid in the other, apply and tell us which way round you are. 🙂



WHAT YOU'D BE DOING



- Conforming and cutting from camera-original media: log, multicam, phone footage mixed in.

- Building story-driven edits out of unscripted material: interviews, brand films, campaign pieces.

- Grading into a consistent house look, and matching shots across cameras.

- Prepping and delivering graded masters our short-form editors cut from, so what you hand over quietly sets the standard downstream.

- Finishing: cleanup, noise management, titles, captions, sound, delivery renders to spec.

- Working to a written delivery spec with one named approver, so nobody has to guess what "done" means.

- Turning client notes around in 
 and keeping projects inside our naming system.



WHAT WE'RE HOPING YOU BRING



- A reel where both sides show: a cut whose structure is the point, and a grade worth looking at.

- Real command of the Color page in DaVinci Resolve. This is the one thing we can't flex on here.

- Shot matching, which honestly matters more to us than one beautiful hero frame.

- Judgment about what to cut, and the ability to say why in a sentence.

- A calibrated display.

- Steadiness across long projects with several client rounds, and an early heads-up if something slips.

- Comfort working in English.



LOVELY BONUSES



VFX work like roto and compositing, Fusion or general finishing, sound design and mixing, experience with AI-assisted workflows, and an opinion about how to build a house LUT worth keeping.



A WORD ON AI 🤖



AI is part of our production. One strand of our work builds pieces out of generated plates and backgrounds, with characters masked or rotoscoped onto them, then retimed and finished in Resolve. If you've worked on something like that, we'd love to hear about it. If you haven't, that's completely fine; it's a bonus rather than a requirement. We also use Claude or ChatGPT day-to-day for prompts and problem-solving.



A NOTE ON YOUR SETUP 💻



Media is big, and we know bandwidth isn't infinite. Because we work in DaVinci Resolve, we can often host the project in Blackmagic Cloud and sync proxies to you, so you'd pull down small files while the originals stay here for the relink. It isn't guaranteed on every project, but it's a real option.



What we need from you is an honest picture of your internet and storage, which the form asks about. There's no secret cutoff. We're matching workflow to what you've actually got.



DAY TO DAY



You'll live in Dropbox (our main media library), Google Drive, Slack, Notion, 
, and Artlist for music and sound effects. We'll set you up on all of it. Own licenses are ideal; if you don't have them, let's talk.



THE PRACTICAL BITS



Contract. Hours are flexible; you tell us what you can commit. Hourly, monthly retainer, or per project. Remote, time zones flexible, with a little US Eastern overlap preferred.



TOOLS YOU'LL RATE



DaVinci Resolve, Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, Capture One, Higgsfield. There's also a checklist where you tick everything else you're strong in, including Fusion and Fairlight.



ONE HONEST NOTE



Our new website isn't live yet, so there isn't much to find if you look us up. We're a small studio partway through a rebrand; the work and the clients are real and ongoing, and you'll be dealing with our founder directly from your first message. Ask us anything you want to check, and we'll send work samples.



WE'RE ALSO HIRING



A Video Editor for short-form paid social and organic, and a Graphic Designer & Photo Retoucher. It's the same application form for all three, so just pick the role you want when you get there. And if you'd genuinely take either editor role, there's an option for that too. 🙂



HOW TO APPLY 💛



Send your work (a reel, ideally showing both a cut and a grade) and fill out the application here:





It asks what you'd like to be paid and how many hours you can commit, because we'd rather hear your number than make you guess ours. It also asks about your setup and for a self-rating on the tools above.



About those ratings: no single one rules you out, and nobody's a 4 across the board. We teach our tools and our workflows. What we can't teach is taste and judgment, so that's what we're really hiring for. Your answers just help us plan your first weeks and pick a good first project.



So please be honest. Rounding up doesn't help you, because the paid test shows where you really are anyway, and an accurate rating means we set you up to win. An honest 1 is genuinely more useful to us than a hopeful 3. 🙂



The scale: 0 never used it, 1 beginner, 2 working, 3 fluent, 4 expert.



Then tick anything you'd love to get better at, plus the short checklist of things you've done on paid or organic work. Gaps are expected. Nobody has all of them.



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



A real person reads every application. If it looks like a fit, we'll reach out for a short friendly call, then a small paid test project, and hopefully a first real project after that.



Being straight with you: we're small, and in this first round we can only reply to the people we're taking forward. If you haven't heard from us in two weeks, it's a no this time. Once you reach the paid test stage, though, you'll always hear back from us personally, whichever way it goes. 🙂

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Senior Software Engineer



About the role

You'll architect new features, drive technical quality, promote best practices, and mentor other engineers, leveraging modern tools to deliver great software effectively.We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer who brings strong foundational software engineering skills and embraces modern development tools, including AI assistants, to enhance productivity and code quality. At Marketplacer, we value engineers who thoughtfully leverage tools like Copilot or LLM assistants to streamline workflows, experiment faster, and focus on solving complex business problems. We view AI tools as an asset to core software engineering, not a replacement for fundamental design, architecture, and problem-solving skills.



What you'll own



Solution Design: Design, implement, and maintain high-performance, scalable, and secure software for our cloud-native SaaS platform.

Data Architecture: Contribute to our data platform, building reliable data models, metrics, and dashboards that support product and operational decisions.

Technical Ownership: Take a piece of work from inception to delivery, including architecture validation and design.

Code Quality: Drive quality through rigorous code reviews, automated testing, and continuous integration.

Mentorship: Provide technical guidance to junior and mid-level engineers.

Continuous Improvement: Champion new ideas and software engineering best practices, including the practical use of developer tools and AI-assisted workflows.

Cross-functional Delivery: Partner closely with Product and UX/UI to ship high-quality features.



What you'll bring



5+ years' experience with object-oriented programming (e.g., Ruby, Python, Java, C#, or similar) and web application frameworks (such as Ruby on Rails). Strong general engineering foundations and adaptability are key.

Hands-on experience incorporating AI coding tools or LLM APIs into daily workflows or features, with a balanced approach to code quality, testing, and security.

Comfort with automated testing, CI/CD, and continuous integration practices.

Solid SQL skills and experience with relational and non-relational databases.

Strong experience with cloud platforms (AWS) and data services.

A track record of building cloud-native solutions and solving real scaling problems.

Experience designing and validating architectures.

Strong communication skills, spoken and written.



How you'll show up



Open, friendly, and collaborative. You are quick to ask for help and just as quick to offer it.

Genuinely excited about new tech and ideas, always learning and experimenting.

A strong product mindset and a drive to solve real-world problems.

Proactive about building cloud-native solutions and tackling scaling challenges.

Committed to DevSecOps practices.

A sharp analytical thinker who enjoys complex problems.

Thoughtful Pragmatist. You are someone who adopts helpful technology to increase leverage without compromising architectural integrity, security, or engineering standards.



Why Marketplacer



At Marketplacer, you’ll be part of a dynamic team driving innovation in the e-commerce and marketplace space. We value collaboration, customer-centricity, and continuous learning. This is your opportunity to shape the success of our platform and grow your career in a supportive and global environment.We view software engineering as a craft that continually evolves with better tools. You'll have real autonomy over technical design and implementation, the opportunity to shape our engineering practices, and a direct impact on building scalable, high-quality software for our platform.



In addition, you’ll have access to:

Remote-first and flexible working environment

Company culture focused on Diversity, Equity & Inclusion 

The ability to work from abroad for up to 30 days each year

Generous referral bonus





Marketplacer is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and experience levels that align with the above.

title: GoHighLevel Agency Builder — Funnels, CRM, Automation & Launch
description:

**$8–$12/hour | ~30 hours/week | Long-Term**



We're launching a new local marketing agency and need a strong **GoHighLevel operator who can help us build the machine behind it.**



Our team handles strategy, advertising, sales, and fulfillment. Your job is to help turn those ideas into clean, working systems inside GHL.



### What You'll Work On



* Funnels and landing pages

* CRM pipelines and opportunity stages

* Calendars and appointment booking

* SMS/email automations and follow-up

* Lead nurture and no-show sequences

* Client onboarding workflows

* Domains, integrations, A2P, and tracking

* GHL snapshots and documentation

* Testing everything before we send paid traffic



Our first project is building the infrastructure for a **brand-new local marketing agency**. We'll be running paid ads and organic campaigns to generate local-business leads, book sales calls, close clients, and onboard them through GHL.



We need someone who can **execute**, not just wait for step-by-step instructions.



If something can be built better, tell us. If something breaks, troubleshoot it. If something can be automated, suggest it.



### Who We're Looking For

We're looking for someone proactive, detail-oriented, comfortable with AI, and interested in becoming a long-term part of our team.

title: Full-Time AI Creative Strategist & Video Editor
description:
Full-Time AI Creative Strategist & Video Editor



Background



We’re a fast-growing social media agency producing high-performing short-form content across Instagram,
, YouTube, and more. WE’RE SCALING FAST!!



This isn't just a job. As the agency grows, the team grows with it. More clients means more volume, higher bonuses, and bigger opportunities for the people who helped build it. We believe in rewarding the people who show up, execute well, and grow with us and we're looking for someone who wants to be part of that from the ground floor.



We’re hiring a full-time AI Creative Strategist to analyze social media data from posted videos, understand content and marketing on a fundamental level, create raw AI clips, and assemble them into polished short-form videos using our internal workflows.



This is a strategy AND execution role. You’ll be taught from the ground up how to actually think like a creator - not just how to follow instructions.



If you haven't used every tool on our stack yet, that's okay. We care much more about having a hunger to learn, strong English, and your ability to improve independently. We'll give you the resources - what you do with them is up to you.



What You'll Do



Creative Strategy & Data

- Analyze the performance of posted videos and understand WHY certain content wins or loses

- Use data to create a feedback loop and continuously improve future videos

- Identify winning hooks, formats, angles, pacing, and creative patterns

- Research competitors, audiences, trends, and high-performing content

- Come to us with what you've learned, what you've changed, and where you need advice - not wait for us to tell you what to do 



Copywriting & Content

- Understand the fundamentals of hooks, storytelling, retention, persuasion, and customer psychology

- Write and improve short-form scripts based on research and performance data

- Identify weaknesses in scripts and creatives before production

- Develop new ideas and angles instead of simply recreating existing content

- Adapt content to different brands, audiences, and niches 



Video Editing

- Turn raw footage and AI-generated assets into high-retention short-form content

- Edit in CapCut with strong pacing, captions, B-roll, overlays, sound design, and visual storytelling

- Develop a strong creative eye and independently identify what needs improvement

- Maintain quality and consistency across multiple client accounts

- Apply feedback quickly and make sure the same mistakes don't keep happening 



AI Content Creation

- Generate AI images, videos, avatars, voices, and other creative assets using our tools

- Use tools such as ChatGPT, Grok, Veo3, and others as part of the creative process

- Experiment with new tools and workflows as AI technology evolves

- Quality check all AI outputs before using them in content

- Learn how to get better outputs instead of relying on us to provide every prompt or solution 



General

- Manage multiple projects without missing deadlines

- Communicate proactively about progress, ideas, problems, and results

- Take ownership of your work from research to final output

- Constantly look for ways to improve your own skills and the team's content

- Solve problems independently before immediately asking for help 



Requirements



Must-Haves

- EXTREMELY STRONG ENGLISH - WRITTEN, SPOKEN, AND COMPREHENSION

- GROWTH MINDSET AND GENUINE HUNGER TO LEARN!!!! 

- Experience editing short-form content - PORTFOLIO REQUIRED

- Strong WiFi connection with rare occurrences of outages

- Strong proficiency in CapCut

- Strong attention to detail and creative quality

- Able to think critically and understand WHY content performs

- Comfortable working with data and using it to improve creative decisions

- Willing to learn copywriting, marketing, AI, editing, and content strategy

- Extremely proactive - you should be coming to us with improvements, not waiting for us to find your mistakes

- Able to research and teach yourself when you don't know something

- Able to take feedback without ego and immediately apply it

- Willing to go above and beyond what is directly assigned

- Able to manage multiple projects without missing deadlines

- Reliable internet and dedicated workspace

- Currently working with NO OTHER CLIENTS. All work commitment should be on this role.



Nice-to-Haves

- Previous agency or content production experience

- Copywriting or direct-response marketing experience

- Experience analyzing social media performance data

- Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, retention, and storytelling

- Experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Grok, Veo3, Kling, or similar tools

- Experience researching competitors, customers, and markets

- Strong understanding of internet culture and social media trends



What We Offer

- Stable, full-time remote role with consistent workload

- Access to all required AI and editing tools

- Copywriting, marketing, editing, and creative strategy resources

- Direct feedback and mentorship on your work

- Access to real performance data so you can understand what actually works

- Freedom to test ideas, experiment, and develop your own creative instincts

- Opportunity to develop skills across editing, AI, copywriting, data analysis, and strategy

- Growth opportunities as we scale

- Performance bonuses of up to 40% of monthly pay.



How to Apply



Include all of the following. INCOMPLETE APPLICATIONS WILL NOT BE REVIEWED:

- Start your application with the word “GROWTH”

- Portfolio or reel (Drive, Notion, or direct links)

- 2-3 of your best short-form content edits

- What AI tools have you used before?

- Short answer (3-5 sentences): If one of your videos significantly underperformed compared to the others, how would you figure out what went wrong and improve the next one?

- Short answer (3-5 sentences): Tell us about something you taught yourself without being asked. How did you learn it?

- Your timezone + working hours

No portfolio = no review.

title: QA & Technical Implementation Associate - Shopify App Platform
description:
Job Overview:

We are seeking a detail-oriented QA & Technical Implementation Associate (1–5 years of hands-on experience) to manage web testing, app configuration, and technical execution for our AI-powered personalization and optimization platform, built specifically for high-growth Shopify brands.



This is an execution-focused, 100% internal technical role. You will be working directly inside our SaaS platform, app codebase, and merchant QA environments. This is strictly non-voice—no client calls, no live chat support, and no customer service.



Work Setup:



Experience Required: 1 to 5 years of commercial experience (Non-Fresh Grads)



Schedule: Full-time



Location: 100% Remote 



Role Type: Non-Voice / Internal Technical QA



Key Responsibilities:

App QA & Campaign Testing: Execute end-to-end functional, visual, cross-browser, responsive, and edge-case testing for custom e-commerce experiences and A/B test variations running through our Shopify app across mobile and desktop.



App Implementation & Setup: Directly configure merchant app parameters, dynamic display logic, and targeting rules within our platform following strict technical specs.



Technical Bug Isolation: Identify, isolate, and document technical defects (e.g., app script conflicts, DOM layout shifts, widget rendering failures) with structured reproduction steps, network/console logs, and visual proof.



Front-End Troubleshooting: Use browser developer tools to inspect injected app elements, isolate HTML/CSS/styling conflicts with merchant themes, and partner with engineering to validate code fixes prior to deployment.



Required Qualifications

Proven Commercial Experience: 1–5 years of solid experience in web QA, SaaS product testing, or front-end technical support (experience working with Shopify apps, e-commerce platforms, or web integrations is required).



Strong DevTools & Front-End Skills: Solid HTML/CSS skills with practical daily experience using Chrome DevTools to inspect DOM elements, inspect network requests/payloads, and debug layout conflicts.



Workflow Mastery: Practical experience using issue-tracking platforms like Jira, Asana, Linear, or Trello to track app bugs from discovery to resolution.



Technical Communication: Excellent written English skills with a proven track record of writing precise, unambiguous bug reports and reproduction steps for developers.



Preferred (Nice-to-Have)

Working knowledge of JavaScript or how third-party scripts interact with Shopify themes.



Prior experience with SaaS products, A/B testing platforms (e.g., VWO, Optimizely, Convert), CRO methodologies, or e-commerce personalization engines.



Note: This Associate-level role requires existing, demonstrable web/SaaS QA experience. It is not an entry-level or fresh-graduate position.



How to Apply

Apply with the exact Subject Line: ASSOCIATE



In the body of your message/application, provide the following:



Resume Link: A view-accessible link to your resume (Google Drive or Dropbox—ensure permissions are set to "Anyone with the link can view").



Technical Summary: A 2–3 sentence summary detailing your 1–5 years of commercial experience with web/SaaS QA workflows, Chrome DevTools debugging, and working within e-commerce or Shopify app environments.



Applications without the correct subject line, missing relevant QA experience, or with restricted resume links will be automatically archived.
