title: Video Editor for Facebook and Instagram Ads (Short Form, Ecommerce, Long Term)
description:
We knit Van Gogh, Monet, Hokusai and Klimt into organic cotton socks, and we sell them across Europe with
 and Instagram ads. You would cut those ads.



Look at what we make first: 
 and 
/kunstsokken



Full time, long term, fully remote. $1,500 a month depending on experience, plus $150 every single time an ad you cut reaches $5,000 in spend. No cap on that bonus.



Start date: Monday 6 October 2026, sooner if you are free.



ABOUT US



Kunstsokken is a Dutch brand. We license artworks from museums and turn them into socks. Van Gogh, Monet, Hokusai, Klimt, Delft Blue, plus direct collaborations with museums. We are based in the Netherlands. The founders are Tako and Jesse.



We sell online, and paid social is our main growth channel. This role lives inside that.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



You turn footage we already own into short ads that stop the scroll.



- Cut 10 to 
 second ads for
 and Instagram.

- Build hooks that land in the first 2 seconds.

- Add burned in captions. We hand you the exact text in Dutch, English, German and French. You do not need to speak any of them. You need to place type carefully and never break a word in the wrong place.

- Mix live footage, product stills with motion, and AI generated shots into one clean cut.

- Deliver the same ad in 9:16, 4:5 and 1:1 when the brief asks. Reframed properly, never stretched.

- Produce alternative hooks for the same ad so we can test the first 2 seconds against each other.

- Edit the occasional Instagram Reel for organic social.



Volume: 8 to 12 finished videos a week, counting hook variants and format versions. Usually 4 to 6 concepts, each shipped in a few cuts.



HOW THE WEEK WORKS



Monday: you get a batch of concept blueprints. Each one has the avatar, the hook, the format, the offer, the landing page and reference ads.

During the week: you ask questions in writing and post rough cuts.

Friday: you deliver the finished batch.

Monday: you get a written scorecard on last week's batch, with the actual ad performance data, plus the new blueprints.



The founder writes the briefs and reviews the work. This is an async role. You will not sit in calls all day. You do have to read a brief properly and ask the right question early instead of guessing.



That Monday scorecard is worth saying twice: you will find out which of your edits made money and which did not. Most editing jobs never tell you.



WHAT YOU GET TO WORK WITH



- A photographer's shot library, with real product and lifestyle footage.

- A separate library of AI generated shots.

- An AI content producer on the team who generates new AI assets on request.

- A photo retoucher who handles product thumbnails, so that is not on your plate.

- A brand kit: fonts, colours, logo, caption scripts, reference ads.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Required:

- 2 or more years editing short form video for paid social or ecommerce. Not wedding videos. Not corporate explainers.

- Strong with at least one of: Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, CapCut Pro.

- You can show us real ads you cut that actually ran on Meta or TikTok.

- You understand hooks, retention, pattern interrupts, and why the first 2 seconds d
 everything.

- Clean caption work. Correct timing, readable type, inside the safe zones.

- Good written English. You work from written briefs.

- A computer that handles 4K edits, and a stable internet connection.

- You can start on 6 October 2026 and commit long term.



Nice to have:

- Motion graphics and simple 2D animation.

- Sound design and music selection for ads.

- Experience with UGC style ads and creator footage.

- Experience bringing product stills to life with motion, pans and parallax.

- An eye for art, design, or anything visual outside of video.



Not required:

- Filming. We do not need a videographer.

- Dutch or any other language. All copy is supplied.



PAY AND TERMS



- $1,500 to $2,000 per month. Where you land depends on your experience and your trial.

- $150 bonus, one time, for every ad you edited that reaches $5,000 in spend within 90 days of launch. No cap on how many ads can earn it.

- Paid monthly through Wise.

- Freelance contractor. You handle your own taxes.

- Paid trial task before we hire, $60, roughly 3 to 4 hours. We pay for it whether or not we hire you.

- You work on your own machine with your own software. If we ever require a specific paid tool, we pay for it.

- The work you deliver for us belongs to Kunstsokken.

- 30 day review after you start. After that, two weeks notice from either side.



HOW TO APPLY



Read this part carefully. Applications that skip a step are not reviewed.



1. Start your application with the word Sterrennacht. First word, nothing before it.

2. Send a link to 3 to 5 short ads you edited yourself. Not a showreel with client logos. Actual ads.

3. For each one, write one line: what was the brief, and what was the hook.

4. Tell us which editing software you use and how long you have used it.

5. Send a screenshot of a speed test and one line describing your computer.

6. Tell us your time zone and which hours you can overlap with 09:00 to 17:00 Central European Time. We need at least 4 hours of overlap.

7. Tell us your expected monthly rate.

8. Confirm you can start on 6 October 2026.

9. Send one ad you did NOT make that you think is excellent, and say in two sentences why it works.



We reply to every application that follows these steps. Shortlisted candidates get the paid trial task, then a 30 minute video call.

We are looking for people who can physically film and create original content for our brand using their own equipment.



We're interested in working with experienced:



* Content creators

* UGC creators

* Videographers

* Fashion/lifestyle creators

* Social media content creators

* Photographers who are also skilled at video



You do not need to edit the videos. In most cases, you can simply send us the raw footage and our team will handle the editing.



What You'll Be Creating



We want to produce a large variety of content for our clothing brand, including:



* Lifestyle and fashion B-roll

* Product close-ups and detail shots

* Outfit and styling content

* Streetwear/lifestyle content

* Indoor and outdoor shoots

* Unboxing videos

* POV-style content

* Aesthetic product shots

* UGC-style content

* Creative product showcases

* Studio-style content

* And more



Most of our content is visual, so speaking on camera is NOT required.



However, if you are comfortable speaking on camera and have good spoken English, this is a big plus.



If you are comfortable modeling our clothing yourself, that's also a plus, but it is not required.



How It Will Work



We will ship our products directly to you.



At the beginning, our team will provide you with references and examples showing the types of shots and content we want.



For example, we may send you a reference video and ask you to film similar shots using our products.



You will film the content and send us the raw footage. Our editing team will take care of turning the footage into finished ads and social media content.



We want this to develop into a long-term partnership.



As you become familiar with our brand, products, customers, and the type of content we like, we want you to gradually become more independent.



Change the subject line to Content Creator when applying.



Eventually, we would love for you to be able to:



* Come up with your own content and shoot ideas

* Find creative ways to showcase our products

* Study our previous content and understand what we're looking for

* Plan and execute shoots with less direction from us



We are not expecting this immediately. We will provide plenty of direction and references when we start working together.



Equipment



You must have your own equipment for filming.



Professional camera equipment is great, but it is not mandatory.



A modern flagship smartphone can also be perfectly fine if you know how to create excellent content with it.



We care much more about the quality of your work than how expensive your equipment is.



You should understand things such as:



* Lighting

* Composition and framing

* Camera movement

* Focus

* Angles

* How to make clothing/products look good on camera

* How to capture useful B-roll for video editors



We're also open to part-time, full-time, freelance, or ongoing contract arrangements. What matters most to us is the quality of your work and your ability to consistently produce content.



We are looking for multiple creators, so please apply even if you think your content style is different from other creators.



Different creators with different styles, locations, appearances, environments, and creative ideas are valuable to us.



Content Volume



We need a lot of new content on an ongoing basis.



There is potential for consistent, high-volume work for creators who perform well.



When applying, please tell us how much content you could realistically film for us each week.



Compensation



Compensation is negotiable and will depend on your experience, content quality, production capabilities, availability, and expected output.



We are open to different arrangements, including per-shoot, per-batch, part-time, full-time, or an ongoing arrangement.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. Send us your portfolio or examples of videos that you personally filmed.



2. What equipment do you currently use for filming?



3. Do you have experience filming clothing, fashion, products, UGC, or social media content? Please explain.



4. Are you able to film in different locations such as outdoors, streets, homes, cafés, gyms, studios, etc.?



5. Approximately how much content could you realistically film each week?



6. What is your preferred pricing/compensation structure?



Please make sure your portfolio shows work that you filmed yourself. We are not hiring video editors for this position.



We are looking to build long-term relationships with talented creators and provide consistent work to people who are a good fit.

title: Inbound Sales & Dispatch VA, US Cleaning Company (Houston & Dallas), Voice, Full Time
description:
ABOUT US



Blank Space is a residential and commercial cleaning company serving Houston and Dallas, Texas. We run on Google Local Services leads, Meta lead ads launching in October, and GoHighLevel. We hold a 5.0 rating in both markets. Our cleaners do the work. You run everything in front of them: the calls, the quotes, the bookings, the schedule, and the cleaner bench.



This is not an inbox job. It is a phone job, a judgment job, and a revenue job.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



Inbound calls and texts, answered within five minutes during your shift.

Qualifying every lead before quoting: bedrooms, bathrooms including half baths, square footage, occupied or empty, pets, condition. Scope gets confirmed in writing before a price goes out.

Quoting from our calculator, booking the job, sending terms and the invoice, and confirming the client signed before service.

Scheduling cleaners, handling same-day changes and no-shows, and keeping clients informed before they have to ask.

Recruiting and screening cleaners in Houston and Dallas so every booked day has a backup.

Chasing unpaid invoices, requesting reviews the day of service, and working old leads that never booked.

Handling complaints using cleaner before and after photos, calmly and inside our policies.

Escalating anyone who is in charge of something, a property manager, business owner, or anyone managing multiple units, directly to the owner. You do not quote them.



WHO WE WANT



Someone who has done this at a real US cleaning or home services company and can prove it. Named company, dates, and the system you used.

Someone who asks questions before quoting. A customer asking "how much" is starting a conversation, not requesting a number.

Someone comfortable on live US phone calls with homeowners, tenants, and business owners.

Hands-on CRM experience. GoHighLevel, Jobber, Housecall Pro, BookingKoala, or Swept preferred.

Houston or Dallas market experience is a plus. Spanish is a plus, not required.



SCHEDULE AND PAY



40 hours per week. Core hours are 11am to 6pm US Central, Monday to Friday, with weekend coverage discussed based on your availability.

Base pay depends on experience. On top of base, you earn a bonus on every job you book that gets paid, and 10% of the first month's revenue on any commercial or recurring account you source and close yourself. Strong performers earn well above base.



HOW TO APPLY



Put "Blank Space VA" and your full name in the subject line. Answer every item below, numbered, in ONE message. Applications that skip items or send only a cover letter will not be reviewed.



LINK RULES, PLEASE READ: Send your video as a Google Drive, Loom, or YouTube (unlisted) link, set to "Anyone with the link can view." Test it in a private browser window before sending. Do NOT send Vocaroo links, folder links, or links that require me to request access. If I cannot open it in one click, the application is incomplete.



1. A two-minute video introduction in English. Tell me about your most recent phone-based role and what a normal day looked like.



2. A SCREENSHOT (not a link) of your speed test showing both download AND upload. Tell me your city and your backup power and backup internet.



3. The last US cleaning or home services company you worked for, by name, with dates, and the CRM you used there. If you have never worked for one, say so.



4. Are you currently working for another client or another cleaning company? Be honest. Tell me who, how many hours, and what your plans are for that client.



5. What days and hours can you work? Are you open to weekend shifts?



6. In your own words, write your reply to this customer text: "Hi, I need a move-out clean for a 3 bedroom 2 bath apartment this Saturday, how much?"



7. A client texts: "The cleaners did a good job but they missed the baseboards. I want a partial refund." Write your exact reply, word for word.



8. A cleaner arrives at a job booked as 2 bedrooms, 1 bath and finds it is actually 2 bedrooms, 2.5 baths. She calls you from the driveway. What do you do, and what do you tell the client?



9. A caller says he manages 40 apartment units and wants a price for turnover cleans. What do you do?



10. Have you ever recruited or screened cleaners or field workers? How, and how many?



11. Do you speak Spanish? Rate yourself 1 to 10. If not, that is fine.



12. Your expected monthly rate for 40 hours.



We read every complete application personally. Take your time and answer properly. The quality of your application is the first sample of your work.

Our internal editors will handle post-production.



For example:



We provide references/creative direction → Your team plans the shoot → You arrange the necessary model/location/props → You film → You send us the organized raw footage → Our team handles editing



As our partnership develops, we want our production partners to become increasingly familiar with our brand.



Over time, we would like you to proactively suggest:



* New shoot concepts

* Locations

* Models

* Props

* Interesting environments

* Different ways to showcase our products

* Content ideas based on our previous successful creatives

* New creative directions worth testing



The goal is to eventually have a production partner who understands our brand well enough that we don't need to provide detailed references for every shoot.



Production Capabilities



Ideally, your studio/team can handle some or all of the following:



* Professional video production

* Lighting

* Studio shoots

* Lifestyle/location shoots

* Indoor and outdoor filming

* Male and female models

* Model/talent sourcing

* Location sourcing

* Props

* Creative direction

* High-volume content production

* Organized raw footage delivery



You do NOT necessarily need to provide every service listed above.



If your team is excellent at a specific type of production, we would still like to hear from you.



Models



Access to models is important.



Our products can be filmed with both male and female creators/models depending on the concept.



Not every piece of content requires someone modeling the clothing. For example, creators can also produce unboxings, product-focused shots, detail shots, aesthetic footage, and other concepts.



Please tell us what type of models/talent you currently have access to and whether you can source additional talent based on a creative brief.



Volume & Long-Term Opportunity



We need a significant amount of content and are interested in studios that have the capacity to produce consistently.



There is potential for substantial recurring work if your content performs well and the partnership works smoothly.



When applying, please tell us your production capacity rather than assuming we only need one shoot.



Compensation



We are open to discussing different pricing structures depending on your capabilities and production setup.



This could include:



* Per shoot

* Per content batch

* Day rates

* Monthly production packages

* Retainer arrangements

* Other long-term arrangements



We value long-term relationships and would prefer to establish an efficient recurring production process rather than renegotiating everything for every individual video.



How to Apply



Please provide:



1. Your studio/company name and location.



2. A link to your portfolio with examples of content that your team has personally filmed/produced.



3. A brief description of your team and production capabilities.



4. What cameras, lighting, audio, and other relevant equipment do you use?



5. Do you have your own studio? If yes, please provide photos or examples of the space.



6. Can you source models based on our requirements?



7. How many shoots could your team realistically handle per week or month?



8. What is your typical turnaround time from receiving a brief to delivering raw footage?



9. What is your typical pricing structure? Please provide examples if possible.



We are looking for reliable production partners who can grow with us over the long term.



If your team can consistently produce great content, there is potential for a significant amount of ongoing work.

title: Dispute Manager (Fashion Dropshipping)
description:
We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Dispute Manager to take full ownership of our payment disputes and chargebacks. Your primary goal will be to protect our payment gateways, compile compelling evidence, and maintain a high dispute win rate for our e-commerce stores.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Manage and respond to all incoming payment disputes and chargebacks across our platforms (e.g., Shopify Payments, Stripe, PayPal).



Investigate each case and build strong, customized evidence packages (tracking info, customer communications, store policies) to win claims.



Track dispute win/loss rates, identify recurring patterns, and advise the customer service team on how to prevent future chargebacks.



Ensure all disputes are handled strictly within the deadlines set by payment processors.



REQUIREMENTS



MUST HAVE: At least 2 years of direct experience in payment dispute and chargeback management.



MUST HAVE: Proven experience working specifically with fashion dropshipping.



HIGHLY PREFERRED: Previous experience handling disputes for high fashion stores.



Strong written English skills and a deep understanding of how to fight "Item Not Received" and "Product Not As Described" claims.



HOW TO APPLY

Please reply with a brief outline of your experience and include the following:



How many years of experience you have in dispute management.



Details of your background in fashion dropshipping and/or high fashion stores.



The names or links of the specific fashion stores you have worked with and their average monthly revenue.



The payment processors you are most familiar with and your average dispute win rate.

title: Shopify Store Builder (AI / Claude-assisted) — Long-term
description:

This is a LONG-TERM role. We plan to build many stores, so we need someone reliable who improves over time and can eventually help us move fast at scale.



WHAT YOU WILL DO:

- Build and customize Shopify stores using Claude (AI) and Shopify's theme editor

- Recreate premium, clean designs based on reference sites we provide

- Add and organize products, collections, and pages

- Handle theme customization (sections, layout, fonts, colors, mobile responsiveness)

- Iterate quickly based on feedback until the result matches our standard



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

- Strong eye for clean, modern, premium design (this is the most important skill)

- Comfortable working with AI tools and writing clear prompts / iterating when the AI makes mistakes

- Hands-on Shopify experience (themes, Liquid basics, apps)

- Fast, reliable, and takes ownership — does not need to be micromanaged

- Good written English



NICE TO HAVE:

- Experience with high-converting DTC / dropshipping stores

Top applicants will be given a small paid test task: recreate one product landing page based on a reference site we provide, within 24 hours.

title: CONTENT PROJECT MANAGER
description:
CONTENT PROJECT MANAGER



Company: Talent Tribe Media

Position: Content Project Manager

Department: Social Media & Content

Reports To: Leadership Team

Location: Remote / Online

Rate: TBD / Based on Experience



ABOUT THE ROLE



Talent Tribe Media is looking for a highly organized, creative, and communicative Content Project Manager to manage content projects across 40+ client brands.



You will be the bridge between leadership, account managers, clients, editors, and the creative team, making sure projects move smoothly from concept to final delivery.



We are looking for someone who can manage projects while also understanding content strategy, storytelling, branding, and social media.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Manage multiple content projects and deadlines across 40+ brands.

Understand each client's brand voice, audience, goals, services, and content strategy.

Turn ideas, client requests, raw footage, and promotions into clear creative projects.

Develop or assist with content concepts, hooks, scripts, captions, CTAs, and creative briefs.

Assign and coordinate projects with editors and creative team members.

Provide editors with clear instructions on story, pacing, branding, footage, and objectives.

Review content drafts and provide specific, actionable feedback.

Coordinate revisions between leadership, clients, account managers, and editors.

Identify missing information, assets, approvals, or other issues that could delay projects.

Maintain quality and consistency across all client content.

Help improve content through stronger hooks, storytelling, messaging, pacing, and CTAs.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



The ideal candidate is:



Highly Organized — Can manage multiple brands, projects, deadlines, and revisions.

A Strong Communicator — Can turn ideas and feedback into clear instructions.

Creative & Strategic — Understands why content works, not just how to manage tasks.

Brand Conscious — Can adapt content to different industries and audiences.

Flexible — Comfortable with changing priorities and fast-moving projects.

Open to Feedback — Comfortable with collaboration and revisions.

Marketing-Minded — Understands hooks, storytelling, engagement, trust, and CTAs.



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



Experience in any of the following is a MUST:



Content or project management

Social media management/strategy

Short-form video / Reels / TikTok

Creative direction

Scriptwriting and copywriting

Content marketing

Brand strategy

Managing editors or creative teams

Client communication

Project-management systems



Experience with a social media, marketing, creative, or production agency is strongly preferred.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



The Content Project Manager should be able to take a simple idea and turn it into a clear, executable project for the creative team.



Editors should know:



What are we creating?

Who is it for?

What is the hook?

What is the story?

What footage should be used?

What is the desired outcome?

What is the CTA?



Ultimately, your job is to help Talent Tribe Media produce better content, faster and more consistently.



HOW TO APPLY



Please submit ALL of the following with a google drive link or paste it here:



1. Current CV / Resume



2. Portfolio / Work Samples

Include relevant social media, video, content, branding, or creative work.



3. Brands / Clients You Have Managed

Please list the brands/companies, industry, your role, and type of content you managed.



4. Previous Salary / Compensation

Please include your previous rate and currency.

Example: PHP 50,000/month or USD $8/hour.



5. Expected Salary / Compensation

Please include your expected rate and currency.



6. Availability

Include your current employment status, earliest start date, preferred working hours, and time zone.



7. Short Introduction

Tell us briefly why you believe you are a good fit for this position.



IMPORTANT



We are looking for someone who can do more than manage tasks. You should be able to understand content, organize people and projects, provide creative direction, and help turn ideas into effective social media content.



Incomplete applications may not be considered.



Talent Tribe Media

Building better content, better systems, and better brands.
